_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Queen's Recruit#000.src: Tasim is looking to catch up in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Queen's Recruit#000.dst: Tasim 想在 {p} 和你敘敘舊，位置 [{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}]。

Queen's Recruit#001.src: {u}! Hey! It's lucky I managed to catch you here.
Queen's Recruit#001.dst: {u}！嘿！能在這裡逮到你真是走運。
Queen's Recruit#001.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#002.src: It's been a while, hasn't it? We should catch up! You've probably had lots of adventures, right?
Queen's Recruit#002.dst: 好一陣子沒見了吧？我們該好好聊聊！你這段時間一定經歷了不少冒險，對吧？
Queen's Recruit#002.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#003.src: But before that... I've just got to find...
Queen's Recruit#003.dst: 不過在那之前……我得先找到……
Queen's Recruit#003.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#004.src: Huh? What am I oh, yeah. I'm trying to find Aledar.
Queen's Recruit#004.dst: 啊？我在找什麼——哦對，我在找 Aledar。
Queen's Recruit#004.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#005.src: He sent me a letter asking me to join him on some... scouting mission. But I haven't been able to find him.
Queen's Recruit#005.dst: 他寄了封信給我，叫我跟他一起去執行什麼……偵察任務。可是我一直找不到人。
Queen's Recruit#005.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#006.src: It did take me a while to get here... so maybe he's gone somewhere else by now. Aegis did tell me the mission ended up being called off, so...
Queen's Recruit#006.dst: 我趕過來是花了不少時間……說不定他早就跑去別的地方了。Aegis 也說那個任務後來取消了，所以……
Queen's Recruit#006.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#007.src: But if he's not here, then I should probably stop trying to catch him on the streets, huh? I'll just leave a message for him at the barracks.
Queen's Recruit#007.dst: 不過既然他不在這裡，我大概也不用再在街上瞎晃了吧？我去兵營給他留個口信就好。
Queen's Recruit#007.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#008.src: We can head to the tavern and catch up! Gods, I've missed the Rusty Recruit's drinks... that barkeeper, he says it's the same as anywhere else, but it really isn't! Nowhere else pours it like he does.
Queen's Recruit#008.dst: 我們可以去酒館好好敘舊！天啊，我好想念 Rusty Recruit 的酒……那個酒保，他老說跟別家沒兩樣，才怪！沒有人倒得出他那個味道。
Queen's Recruit#008.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#009.src: Pardon me, excuse me coming through! Coming through! Ah, you two! Just the folks I was looking for.
Queen's Recruit#009.dst: 抱歉借過，借過一下！借過！啊，你們兩位！我要找的正是你們。
Queen's Recruit#009.speaker: Ragni Courier

Queen's Recruit#011.src: Well, perhaps not specifically. I've got a list of folks to try and track down, and the two of you are on it! Tasim and {u}, right?
Queen's Recruit#011.dst: 呃，也不算指名啦。我手上有一長串要找的人，你們兩位都在上面！Tasim 和 {u}，沒錯吧？
Queen's Recruit#011.speaker: Ragni Courier

Queen's Recruit#012.src: I've got an important missive from {p}. Direct from the King himself, yep yep!
Queen's Recruit#012.dst: 我這裡有一封從 {p} 來的重要公文。國王親自下的，沒錯沒錯！
Queen's Recruit#012.speaker: Ragni Courier

Queen's Recruit#013.src: Really? I don't think I've seen him since... what could he possibly want us for?
Queen's Recruit#013.dst: 真的？我上次見到他好像是……他到底找我們做什麼？
Queen's Recruit#013.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#014.src: I'm not privy to the details I'm afraid! He's summoning a number of you seasoned visitors to the castle, for some sort of meeting.
Queen's Recruit#014.dst: 詳情我可就不清楚了！他要召集一批像你們這樣的資深訪客到城堡去，好像是要開什麼會。
Queen's Recruit#014.speaker: Ragni Courier

Queen's Recruit#015.src: Anyway, I've got more to try and track down, so I'll give you the written letters and be on my way! Best of luck with whatever it is!
Queen's Recruit#015.dst: 總之，我還有其他人要找，把信交給你們我就先走一步了！不管是什麼事，祝你們順利！
Queen's Recruit#015.speaker: Ragni Courier

Queen's Recruit#017.src: Hm. That is strange, isn't it? I guess we'll have to call off drinks for later... probably for the best. Maybe I'll be able to catch him before...
Queen's Recruit#017.dst: 嗯。這事很奇怪吧？看來喝酒得改天了……不過這樣也好。說不定我還能趕在那之前找到他……
Queen's Recruit#017.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#018.src: Oh, uh you go on ahead. I have to stop by the barracks first. I'll meet you in {p}, then?
Queen's Recruit#018.dst: 哦，呃——你先過去吧。我得先繞去兵營一趟。那我們在 {p} 會合？
Queen's Recruit#018.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#019.src: I'll meet you in {p}. I have to deal with some things at the barracks first.
Queen's Recruit#019.dst: 我們在 {p} 會合。我得先去兵營處理一些事。
Queen's Recruit#019.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#020.src: Attend the meeting with the King in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Queen's Recruit#021.src: ...oh, there you are. Didn't you head out before me?
Queen's Recruit#021.dst: ……哦，你在這啊。你不是比我先出發的嗎？
Queen's Recruit#021.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#022.src: I don't know most of the people here, so I'll stick with you for now.
Queen's Recruit#022.dst: 這裡的人我大多不認識，我先跟著你吧。
Queen's Recruit#022.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#023.src: ...and it's all crashing down, right? So I knock the zombie back, grab the kid, and jump for
Queen's Recruit#023.dst: ……然後整座建築就這樣塌下來，對吧？所以我把殭屍打退，一把抓住那孩子，往下跳——
Queen's Recruit#023.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#024.src: Wait, wait wait wait you're tellin' me there was a kid involved? And you still set off the bombs?!
Queen's Recruit#024.dst: 等等、等等等等——你是說裡面還有個小孩？結果你還是把炸彈引爆了？！
Queen's Recruit#024.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#025.src: Yeah! I said that already, right? That was the whole reason I
Queen's Recruit#025.dst: 對啊！我剛剛不就講過了嗎？那才是我為什麼要——
Queen's Recruit#025.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#026.src: Ahem. Pause the story for a bit, Linton. We have company.
Queen's Recruit#026.dst: 咳咳。故事先停一下，Linton。有客人來了。
Queen's Recruit#026.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#027.src: Well if it ain't {u}! It's good to see someone else familiar 'round here.
Queen's Recruit#027.dst: 哎唷，這不是 {u} 嗎！在這種地方看到熟面孔真好。
Queen's Recruit#027.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#028.dst: 什麼，那我就不是熟面孔了？
Queen's Recruit#028.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#029.src: I do try to keep my distance.
Queen's Recruit#029.dst: 我是盡量跟你保持距離啦。
Queen's Recruit#029.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#030.src: So, you received the summons too? The King has a lot of people here. It's interesting.
Queen's Recruit#030.dst: 你們也收到召集令了？國王找來了不少人呢。有意思。
Queen's Recruit#030.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#031.src: We did, yes. And it sounded like they had even more people on that list that they were searching for.
Queen's Recruit#031.dst: 是啊，我們也收到了。而且聽起來名單上還有更多人在找。
Queen's Recruit#031.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#032.src: Oh, apologies, I hadn't noticed you there. You're a friend of {u}'s, I take it?
Queen's Recruit#032.dst: 哦，抱歉，我剛才沒注意到你。你是 {u} 的朋友吧？
Queen's Recruit#032.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#033.src: I am! We arrived in Wynn on the same caravan. I'm Tasim.
Queen's Recruit#033.dst: 是的！我們是坐同一輛馬車來到 Wynn 的。我叫 Tasim。
Queen's Recruit#033.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#035.src: So you're the one Aledar was always talking about! I thought you were off in Gavel?
Queen's Recruit#035.dst: 所以你就是 Aledar 老掛在嘴邊的那個人！我還以為你跑去 Gavel 了？
Queen's Recruit#035.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#036.src: I... was. How do you all know him?
Queen's Recruit#036.dst: 我……是去了。你們怎麼會認識他？
Queen's Recruit#036.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#037.src: I believe we first met on a mission to reclaim {p}'s barracks from a treasonous commander. We've run into each other a few times since.
Queen's Recruit#037.dst: 我記得我們第一次見面，是去 {p} 的兵營平定一個叛變指揮官的任務。後來又碰過幾次面。
Queen's Recruit#037.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#038.src: Still, it's good to finally get t' meet you! We've heard lots of stories! Including somethin' about not respondin' to letters...?
Queen's Recruit#038.dst: 總之，總算見到本人真好！我們聽過好多你的事！包括什麼……不回信之類的？
Queen's Recruit#038.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#039.src: Oh... right. We, uh... sorted that out.
Queen's Recruit#039.dst: 哦……對。那件事我們，呃……已經講開了。
Queen's Recruit#039.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#040.src: But speaking of have any of you seen him recently?
Queen's Recruit#040.dst: 說到這個——你們最近有誰見過他嗎？
Queen's Recruit#040.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#041.src: 'fraid not. I don't think our paths've crossed since... was it the siege at {p}? Must've been.
Queen's Recruit#041.dst: 恐怕沒有。我想我們上次碰面是在……{p} 的圍城戰？應該是吧。
Queen's Recruit#041.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#042.src: I saw him a month ago in {p}! I asked him what he was working on and if I could help and he just brushed me off. Weird, right?
Queen's Recruit#042.dst: 我一個月前在 {p} 見過他！我問他在忙什麼、我能不能幫忙，他直接把我打發掉了。很怪吧？
Queen's Recruit#042.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#043.src: Mmn. No, that sounds like him. I think he had enough of your antics last time.
Queen's Recruit#043.dst: 嗯。不會啊，那很像他的作風。我猜他上次已經受夠你那些鬧劇了。
Queen's Recruit#043.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#044.src: What?! I'm capable. C'mon, Mel, tell her I'm capable.
Queen's Recruit#044.dst: 什麼？！我很能幹的。來嘛，Mel，跟她說我很能幹。
Queen's Recruit#044.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#045.src: Linton, y'were just tellin' us about how you caved in a whole temple by
Queen's Recruit#045.dst: Linton，你剛剛才在跟我們說你怎麼把一整座神殿弄塌的——
Queen's Recruit#045.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#046.src: Okay! Okay, okay okay, let's talk about literally anything else! Tasim, right? What's... uh...
Queen's Recruit#046.dst: 好啦！好好好，我們聊點別的，什麼都好！Tasim，對吧？你的……呃……
Queen's Recruit#046.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#047.src: ...so, your... no, no, give me a moment you were... and... um... oh, right...
Queen's Recruit#047.dst: ……所以，你的……不對，不對，等我一下——你剛才……然後……呃……哦，對了……
Queen's Recruit#047.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#050.src: Linton!! Y'can't just ask someone that!!
Queen's Recruit#050.dst: Linton！！這種事怎麼可以隨口就問！！
Queen's Recruit#050.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#052.src: It was nice meeting you, Tasim. I look forward to working with you during this mission.
Queen's Recruit#052.dst: 很高興認識你，Tasim。期待這次任務跟你合作。
Queen's Recruit#052.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#053.src: ...likewise. It's always nice meeting friends of Aledar.
Queen's Recruit#053.dst: ……我也是。認識 Aledar 的朋友總是件好事。
Queen's Recruit#053.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#054.src: Well, look at you! It's been quite a time since we last spoke. Far above the task of cleaning out sewers now, eh?
Queen's Recruit#054.dst: 哎唷，瞧瞧你！我們上次說話已經是好久以前了。現在早就不必再去清水溝了吧，嗯？
Queen's Recruit#054.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#055.src: I've heard some tell of your accomplishments. Fine work, fine work.
Queen's Recruit#055.dst: 我聽說了你的一些事蹟。幹得好，幹得好。
Queen's Recruit#055.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#056.src: And... hm. Aren't you the one who ran off to Gavel without sayin' a word? Didn't expect you to be one o' the ones picked out for this.
Queen's Recruit#056.dst: 還有……嗯。你不就是那個一聲不吭就跑去 Gavel 的傢伙？沒想到這次會選上你。
Queen's Recruit#056.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#057.src: I... didn't expect it either. I didn't even realize the King still remembered me, truth be told.
Queen's Recruit#057.dst: 我……我自己也沒想到。老實說，我根本不知道國王還記得我。
Queen's Recruit#057.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#058.src: Mmn. Well, whatever the reason, you're here now. Don't suppose it matters much the path you took to get here. We need all the folks we can get or so Kymer's been sayin'.
Queen's Recruit#058.dst: 嗯。算了，不管什麼理由，你人都在這了。怎麼走到這一步大概也不重要。我們現在是能找幾個人就要幾個人——Kymer 是這麼說的。
Queen's Recruit#058.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#059.src: Well well! If my eyes don't deceive me! {u} and Tasim!
Queen's Recruit#059.dst: 哎呀呀！要是我沒看錯的話！{u} 和 Tasim！
Queen's Recruit#059.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#060.src: I'll say, I didn't quite expect them to track you down! What with your... extended stint off in Gavel.
Queen's Recruit#060.dst: 我得說，我還真沒想到他們找得到你們！畢竟你們……在 Gavel 待了那麼久。
Queen's Recruit#060.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#061.src: I should say the same about you, captain. Did {p} no longer have a use for you once the war ended?
Queen's Recruit#061.dst: 這句話我也該還給你，隊長。戰爭結束之後，{p} 是不是就用不上你了？
Queen's Recruit#061.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#062.src: Ah... nothing of the sort. You know, I was sent out there initially to serve as more of an envoy from {p}! If the King needs a diplomatic situation sorted, I'm the one he turns to first.
Queen's Recruit#062.dst: 啊……沒有的事。你要知道，我當初被派去那邊，比較像是 {p} 的外交使節！國王要是有什麼外交場面要擺平，第一個想到的就是我。
Queen's Recruit#062.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#063.src: Which... is indeed why I am here now. I was recalled rather abruptly several weeks ago. It seems we've entered a tricky situation with our... neighboring province.
Queen's Recruit#063.dst: 而……我這次來這裡，也正是這個緣故。幾週前我被相當突然地召了回來。看來我們和那個……鄰省之間，陷入了一點微妙的局面。
Queen's Recruit#063.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#064.src: But! I shan't say more before the King arrives. He'll tell you all of the problem that hopefully we will be able to resolve.
Queen's Recruit#064.dst: 不過！國王來之前我不便多說。他會把整件事告訴各位——但願我們有辦法解決。
Queen's Recruit#064.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#065.src: ...I see. We'll leave you to it, then.
Queen's Recruit#065.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#066.src: If we align the manaflow with Water, then nudge it to the side, maybe... ah Reynauld, pass me my notes on... damn, what was it oh, yes, the recovery period! Pass me those ones.
Queen's Recruit#066.dst: 如果我們把魔力流對到水元素，再往旁邊推一點，也許……啊，Reynauld，把我那份筆記拿來——該死，是哪一份來著——哦對，恢復期那份！把那份拿給我。
Queen's Recruit#066.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#067.src: ...You already have them on your left, doctor.
Queen's Recruit#067.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#068.src: Do I now! It seems I do... oh, but this is only the first half where did I leave the rest...
Queen's Recruit#068.dst: 是嗎！好像真的是……哦，可是這只有前半啊——我把剩下的放到哪去了……
Queen's Recruit#068.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#069.src: Sigh... If you'd just allow me to organize for you, maybe you wouldn't
Queen's Recruit#069.dst: 唉……您要是肯讓我幫您整理，說不定就不會——
Queen's Recruit#069.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#070.src: And ruin my predefined sorting system?! No, Reynauld, I do think it works perfectly well as it is, thank you very much! Now, where could it have
Queen's Recruit#070.dst: 然後毀掉我既定的分類系統？！不行，Reynauld，我認為它現在運作得非常良好，多謝關心！好了，它到底會在哪——
Queen's Recruit#070.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#071.src: Ah! You two! Good, good, you're here I was worried Reynauld would be the only other one with recovered memories around here!
Queen's Recruit#071.dst: 啊！你們兩個！太好了、太好了，你們來了——我還擔心這裡除了 Reynauld 就沒有第二個恢復記憶的人了！
Queen's Recruit#071.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#072.src: What, you didn't test it on anyone else after we left?
Queen's Recruit#072.dst: 什麼，我們走了之後你沒再拿別人試過？
Queen's Recruit#072.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#073.src: Test it on no, of course not! After what I saw? No, no, that would certainly not have been worth the risk. No new test subjects until I am certain it's flawless!
Queen's Recruit#073.dst: 拿別人試——當然沒有！在我親眼見過那種景象之後？不行、不行，那個風險絕對不值得。在我確定它萬無一失之前，不會再有新的受試者！
Queen's Recruit#073.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#074.src: I've been using it on myself instead! And, let me tell you the breakthroughs I have made... there is much to be learned.
Queen's Recruit#074.dst: 我改成用在我自己身上了！而且我跟你們說——我取得的突破……有太多東西可以學了。
Queen's Recruit#074.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#076.src: Pah! "Safety" a meaningless term made only to stifle progress. Have there been side effects certainly! But it has all been worth it.
Queen's Recruit#076.dst: 呸！「安全」——那不過是個為了扼殺進展而發明出來的空話。有沒有副作用——當然有！但一切都值得。
Queen's Recruit#076.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#077.src: Now, I must return to the pages... I've some equations I need to perfect before the King arrives...
Queen's Recruit#077.dst: 好了，我得回去看我的稿子了……國王來之前我還有幾道式子要推完……
Queen's Recruit#077.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#078.src: Hm. I can't say I would have expected you to be here, Tasim.
Queen's Recruit#078.dst: 嗯。我倒是沒想過會在這裡見到你，Tasim。
Queen's Recruit#078.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#079.src: Well... fate has other plans, I guess. How about you? Did you stay in {p}?
Queen's Recruit#079.dst: 嗯……大概是命運另有安排吧。你呢？你一直待在 {p} 嗎？
Queen's Recruit#079.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#080.src: Mostly. Moved around for a few assignments here and there, but I kept coming back.
Queen's Recruit#080.dst: 大致上是。中間為了幾個任務調動過，但每次都又回去了。
Queen's Recruit#080.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#081.src: ...we haven't spoken in a while. Are you... doing well? How have you been managing the memories?
Queen's Recruit#081.dst: ……我們很久沒說過話了。你……還好嗎？那些記憶，你處理得還可以嗎？
Queen's Recruit#081.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#083.src: As well as I could be expected to, I guess. It was rough for the first few months. Eventually, I got used to it.
Queen's Recruit#083.dst: 就跟大家預期的差不多吧。頭幾個月很難熬。後來也就習慣了。
Queen's Recruit#083.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#084.src: How about you? I also wouldn't have expected you to show for a mission like this.
Queen's Recruit#084.dst: 你呢？我也沒想到你會出現在這種任務上。
Queen's Recruit#084.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#085.src: Same as you. Helped that Caid and I managed to talk it through. We meet every so often, talk about it. He talks about his sister, how he wants to find her one day.
Queen's Recruit#085.dst: 跟你一樣。還好 Caid 和我把話講開了。我們偶爾會見個面，聊聊那些事。他常提起他妹妹，說他總有一天要把她找回來。
Queen's Recruit#085.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#087.src: Hm. Nothing stopping you from stopping by, yourself. It might even help you.
Queen's Recruit#087.dst: 嗯。你自己也不是不能來坐坐。說不定對你也有幫助。
Queen's Recruit#087.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#088.src: I'll... consider it. Good to see you again, Reynauld.
Queen's Recruit#088.dst: 我……會考慮的。很高興再見到你，Reynauld。
Queen's Recruit#088.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#089.src: Another soldier? Allow me to see your summons.
Queen's Recruit#089.dst: 又一個士兵？請出示你的召集令。
Queen's Recruit#089.speaker: Ragni Guard

Queen's Recruit#090.src: ...good. Come on in, {u}. The King will be arriving shortly.
Queen's Recruit#090.dst: ……很好。請進，{u}。國王很快就會到了。
Queen's Recruit#090.speaker: Ragni Guard

Queen's Recruit#092.src: If you insist. Don't take too long.
Queen's Recruit#092.dst: 你堅持的話就去吧。別待太久。
Queen's Recruit#092.speaker: Ragni Guard

Queen's Recruit#093.src: Ah... here we are. I thank you all for coming on such short notice. It has been some time since I have seen many of you.
Queen's Recruit#093.dst: 啊……人都到齊了。感謝各位在這麼倉促的時間內趕來。我已有好一段時間未見到你們許多人了。
Queen's Recruit#093.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#094.src: ...I'll get right to the point. We find ourselves in a very delicate position when it comes to relations with our neighboring province, Fruma.
Queen's Recruit#094.dst: ……我就直說了。在與鄰省 Fruma 的關係上，我們正處於極其微妙的位置。
Queen's Recruit#094.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#095.src: We rely heavily on the flow of new recruits sent to us, but we have no means of contacting their province. Only they may reach out to us, and only once they have chosen to do so.
Queen's Recruit#095.dst: 我們高度仰賴他們送來的新兵，卻沒有任何辦法主動聯繫那個行省。只有他們能找上我們，而且得等他們自己願意。
Queen's Recruit#095.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#096.src: ...several weeks ago, we received a cloaked visitor through the outskirts. She claimed to be of Fruma, one of their Sovereigns.
Queen's Recruit#096.dst: ……數週前，有一位罩著斗篷的訪客從外緣進入我國。她自稱來自 Fruma，是他們的統領之一。
Queen's Recruit#096.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#097.src: We were extended an invitation, of sorts. Of all the recruits we have ever received, we were to select the greatest, and send them into Fruma for some sort of celebration.
Queen's Recruit#097.dst: 我們收到了一份……姑且稱之為邀請。要我們從歷來所有的新兵之中，挑出最傑出的一批，送進 Fruma 參加某種慶典。
Queen's Recruit#097.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#098.src: Is that who we are? The greatest?
Queen's Recruit#098.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#099.src: The ones that could be reached, at the very least! Perhaps some were greater yet, but we all know the roaming habits of your sort, and tracking them down really can prove
Queen's Recruit#099.dst: 至少是找得到的那些！說不定還有更厲害的，可是各位也曉得你們這種人四處漂泊的習性，要追查起來實在是——
Queen's Recruit#099.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#100.src: Ugh, we're not going along with this, are we?
Queen's Recruit#100.dst: 唉，我們該不會真的要照做吧？
Queen's Recruit#100.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#102.src: What? They're demanding something weird and obviously suspicious, so why should we just accept it?
Queen's Recruit#102.dst: 怎樣？他們提出一個又怪又明顯可疑的要求，我們憑什麼就這樣接受？
Queen's Recruit#102.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#103.src: I'm afraid we don't have a choice in the matter. As I mentioned, the recruits we receive make all the difference in our province's continued survival. If we were to reject this invitation...
Queen's Recruit#103.dst: 恐怕這件事我們沒有選擇的餘地。正如我所說，我們收到的新兵，關乎本行省能否繼續存續。倘若我們回絕這份邀請……
Queen's Recruit#103.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#104.src: ...who's to say they wouldn't just stop sendin' 'em, eh? Tough.
Queen's Recruit#104.dst: ……誰敢說他們不會乾脆不送了，是吧？難辦啊。
Queen's Recruit#104.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#105.src: Besides all that, think of the opportunity this presents! A true, freely-given view of what lies beyond those walls! We'd be fools not to accept it, no matter the implied threat!
Queen's Recruit#105.dst: 更別說，想想這是多難得的機會！一次真正的、對方主動給的，看見那道牆後面究竟有什麼的機會！不接受才是傻子，就算那底下藏著威脅也一樣！
Queen's Recruit#105.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#106.src: Indeed. I regret that I must request this of you... but there is no other choice. You must accept this invitation.
Queen's Recruit#106.dst: 正是如此。要向各位提出這種要求，我深感抱歉……但別無選擇。你們必須接受這份邀請。
Queen's Recruit#106.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#107.src: ...even those of us with bad experiences of the province?
Queen's Recruit#107.dst: ……包括我們這些在那個行省有過不好回憶的人？
Queen's Recruit#107.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#108.src: I apologize... but you must. My hands are tied.
Queen's Recruit#108.dst: 我很抱歉……但你必須去。我也無能為力。
Queen's Recruit#108.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#109.src: I take it we are expected to gather as much intelligence on Fruma as we can while we're in there?
Queen's Recruit#109.dst: 我想，我們同時也被期待在那裡盡可能蒐集關於 Fruma 的情報？
Queen's Recruit#109.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#110.src: That's the plan, indeed! I'll explain more once we're there, but I believe we're on a time limit, correct?
Queen's Recruit#110.dst: 正是這個打算！細節等我們到了那邊我再說明，不過我們應該是有時限的，對吧？
Queen's Recruit#110.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#111.src: You are correct, doctor. I have been told that a representative will greet you all at the royal gates of Fruma, situated on the western coast.
Queen's Recruit#111.dst: 你說得沒錯，博士。我得到的消息是，會有一位代表在 Fruma 的皇家城門迎接各位，地點在西岸。
Queen's Recruit#111.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#112.src: I've sent a courier ahead to {p} to inform the local captains of the destination they are to take you to.
Queen's Recruit#112.dst: 我已先派信差前往 {p}，通知當地的船長們要把各位送往何處。
Queen's Recruit#112.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#113.src: {p}... I know a captain there. {u}, want to join me?
Queen's Recruit#113.dst: {p}……我認識那裡的一位船長。{u}，要一起走嗎？
Queen's Recruit#113.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#114.src: Finally... a glimpse at the province's inner workings... how long have I been seeking these answers?
Queen's Recruit#114.dst: 總算……能一窺那個行省的內部運作了……我追這些答案追了多久了？
Queen's Recruit#114.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#115.src: So many theories... how many will be proven right? How many will be wrong? I cannot wait to find out!
Queen's Recruit#115.dst: 這麼多假說……會有幾個被證實？又有幾個會被推翻？我等不及要知道了！
Queen's Recruit#115.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#116.src: Sigh... I did know this was coming. Why else would the doctor have been summoned? But I hoped I was wrong.
Queen's Recruit#116.dst: 唉……我早知道會有這一天。不然博士為什麼會被召來？只是我一直希望自己想錯了。
Queen's Recruit#116.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#117.src: Tough situation, isn't it? Lots o' secrecy on part of the Frumans...
Queen's Recruit#117.dst: 局面很棘手，是吧？Fruma 人那邊藏了太多事……
Queen's Recruit#117.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#118.src: But we'll handle it. Everyone here's plenty capable, after all.
Queen's Recruit#118.dst: 不過我們應付得來。畢竟在場每一個都有兩把刷子。
Queen's Recruit#118.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#119.src: Hm... what a situation it is we find ourselves in! Diplomacy is my specialty, of course, but my expertise has not prepared me for... this.
Queen's Recruit#119.dst: 嗯……我們攤上的可真是個場面！外交當然是我的專長，但我這身本事，沒為……這種事做過準備。
Queen's Recruit#119.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#120.src: Fruma knows what they want, and know they are strong enough that they can afford to let up their position.
Queen's Recruit#120.dst: Fruma 清楚自己要什麼，也清楚自己強到可以隨時鬆手不談。
Queen's Recruit#120.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#121.src: Another top secret mission already? And I'm not even allowed to bring my explosives?
Queen's Recruit#121.dst: 又是一個最高機密任務？而且還不准我帶炸藥？
Queen's Recruit#121.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#122.src: It's interesting, at least! Way better than that last assignment...
Queen's Recruit#122.dst: 至少有意思！比上一個差事好太多了……
Queen's Recruit#122.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#123.src: This mission's a big deal, huh? Lot's o' strong folks recalled for it, at least.
Queen's Recruit#123.dst: 這次任務不小吧？光看被召回來的高手就這麼多。
Queen's Recruit#123.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#124.src: Makes me a bit nervous, honestly!
Queen's Recruit#124.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#125.src: Fruma... I can't say it's been on my mind much. It's a mystery, yes, but not one with any available answers.
Queen's Recruit#125.dst: Fruma……我不能說我常想到它。它是個謎沒錯，但那是個問不到答案的謎。
Queen's Recruit#125.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#126.src: Well, until now, I suppose. I'll have to prepare a list of details to look out for...
Queen's Recruit#126.dst: 嗯，不過現在大概不一樣了。我得先列一份該留意的細節清單……
Queen's Recruit#126.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#127.src: And yet again, I must send you all into danger... a different sort, this time around, but danger nonetheless.
Queen's Recruit#127.dst: 我又一次，必須把各位送入險境……這一次的險境形式不同，但終究是險境。
Queen's Recruit#127.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#128.src: I remember each face which passes through my castle. I rarely see any of them again.
Queen's Recruit#128.dst: 每一張經過我城堡的臉，我都記得。而我很少能再見到他們第二次。
Queen's Recruit#128.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#129.src: But this time... I have faith we will meet once more. Go on, young hero. YOur mission lies ahead of you.
Queen's Recruit#129.dst: 但這一次……我有信心我們會再相見。去吧，年輕的英雄。你的任務就在前方。
Queen's Recruit#129.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#130.src: ...back to Fruma. I've only just come back to Wynn, and now...
Queen's Recruit#130.dst: ……回 Fruma。我才剛回到 Wynn，現在卻……
Queen's Recruit#130.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#131.src: But it had to happen eventually. And I do want answers. So... in we go.
Queen's Recruit#131.dst: 不過這一天遲早要來的。而且我確實想要答案。所以……走吧。
Queen's Recruit#131.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#132.src: I'll be heading to the {p} Seaskipper, if you want to tag along.
Queen's Recruit#132.dst: 我會先到 {p} 的渡船口，你想跟就一起來。
Queen's Recruit#132.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#133.src: Travel to the Gate of Fruma at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] or meet up with Tasim in {p}.
Queen's Recruit#133.dst: 前往 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 的 Fruma 城門，或在 {p} 與 Tasim 會合。

Queen's Recruit#134.src: ...Oh! You're here! Lost in thought, sorry.
Queen's Recruit#134.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#135.src: It's all a little surreal, isn't it? I only just got back to Wynn, and now... Fruma!
Queen's Recruit#135.dst: 整件事有點不真實，對吧？我才剛回到 Wynn，結果現在……要去 Fruma！
Queen's Recruit#135.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#136.src: Kind of make me wish we had Aledar here too. The three of us on an adventure again! Going back... home...
Queen's Recruit#136.dst: 這種時候還真希望 Aledar 也在。我們三個又能一起冒險了！而且是回……老家……
Queen's Recruit#136.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#137.src: I guess we'll just have to tell him all about it when we get back. He'll be sad he missed it, I bet.
Queen's Recruit#137.dst: 我想我們只能等回去之後再跟他好好講一遍了。他一定會很扼腕自己錯過。
Queen's Recruit#137.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#138.src: Oi, there! Are those my two favorite customers I see?
Queen's Recruit#138.dst: 喂，那邊的！我看到的該不會是我兩位最喜歡的客人吧？
Queen's Recruit#138.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#139.src: You call everyone your favorite customer, captain! Don't think I didn't notice!
Queen's Recruit#139.dst: 你對誰都說是最喜歡的客人啊，船長！別以為我沒發現！
Queen's Recruit#139.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#140.src: Eheheheh, well, it's true, ain't it? I got lots o' favorites! Ah, anyhow, you're here for a trip, ain't'cha?
Queen's Recruit#140.dst: 嘿嘿嘿，可那也是真的嘛，不是嗎？我最喜歡的客人多的是！啊，總之，你們是要搭船的吧？
Queen's Recruit#140.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#141.src: We are! You've... probably heard the details already? There should have been something about a new destination.
Queen's Recruit#141.dst: 是的！你……應該已經聽說細節了吧？應該有人提過一個新的目的地。
Queen's Recruit#141.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#142.src: Aye. That I have. Some scrawny {p} courier wooshed past earlier! I barely got a word in before he was off again! Real interesting fellow.
Queen's Recruit#142.dst: 有啊。這我聽說了。剛才有個瘦巴巴的 {p} 信差咻一下衝過去！我一句話都還沒插上，他人就沒影了！真是個有意思的傢伙。
Queen's Recruit#142.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#143.src: ... Not a part o' the sea I like to visit, but I reckon I can make an exception this time.
Queen's Recruit#143.dst: ……那片海不是我愛去的地方，不過這回我想可以破個例。
Queen's Recruit#143.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#144.src: Hm... I can pay you extra for the trip, if you'd like.
Queen's Recruit#144.dst: 嗯……如果你願意的話，這趟我可以多付一些。
Queen's Recruit#144.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#145.src: Ha! No, no, there's no need for that. It's free of charge for my two favorite customers, eheh!
Queen's Recruit#145.dst: 哈！不用不用，不必這樣。給我兩位最喜歡的客人，免費，嘿嘿！
Queen's Recruit#145.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#146.src: ...and, 'course, s'all paid for from {p}'s royal coffers anyhow. Now, hop on abour 'fore I change my mind and leave without ya!
Queen's Recruit#146.dst: ……而且啊，這趟本來就是 {p} 的國庫在出錢。好了，快上船，免得我改變主意丟下你們！
Queen's Recruit#146.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#148.src: ...Oh! You're here! Lost in thought, sorry.
Queen's Recruit#148.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#149.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#150.dst: 這種時候還真希望 Aledar 也在。我們三個又能一起冒險了！而且是回……老家……
