Queen's Recruit#160.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#162.src: ...so, Fruma, eh? I'd ask what business ya've got there, but... figure it's top secret.
Queen's Recruit#162.dst: ……所以，是要去 Fruma 啊？我本來想問你們去那邊辦什麼事，不過……我猜是最高機密吧。
Queen's Recruit#162.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#163.src: We've been... invited into the province. Supposedly, it's for some sort of celebration, but...
Queen's Recruit#163.dst: 我們……是被邀請進那個行省的。名義上是某種慶典，可是……
Queen's Recruit#163.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#164.src: Mmn. Aye, knowin' the rumors... not the kind o' place to just invite folks in, is it?
Queen's Recruit#164.dst: 嗯。是啊，聽那些傳言……那可不是個會隨便請人進去的地方，對吧？
Queen's Recruit#164.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#167.src: Tell me, what's on yer mind then? The both o' you. Speakin' thoughts out tends to make 'em easier to manage, in my experience.
Queen's Recruit#167.dst: 那說說看，你們心裡在想什麼？你們兩個都是。照我的經驗，把想法說出口，它就比較好收拾了。
Queen's Recruit#167.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#168.src: Fruma went through all that trouble to erase our memories, to get rid of us... just to ask for us back out of nowhere.
Queen's Recruit#168.dst: Fruma 費了那麼大的工夫抹掉我們的記憶、把我們趕出去……卻又莫名其妙地把我們要回去。
Queen's Recruit#168.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#169.src: I don't know why they're doing it, but I'm worried there's more going on.
Queen's Recruit#169.dst: 我不知道他們為什麼要這麼做，但我怕背後還有別的事。
Queen's Recruit#169.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#170.src: I've not got more of a clue than either o' you, but I reckon that suspicion is warranted.
Queen's Recruit#170.dst: 我知道的不比你們兩個多，不過我覺得這份疑心是有道理的。
Queen's Recruit#170.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#171.src: But don't let it consume you, aye? Some suspicion is healthy, but if it colors everything ya do, it'll hurt ya just as bad as naivety would. Keep an open mind.
Queen's Recruit#171.dst: 可別讓它把你吞了，好嗎？留點疑心是健康的，可要是它染上你做的每一件事，它傷你的程度不會比天真無知輕。心放寬一點。
Queen's Recruit#171.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#172.src: ...it's possible. I hope you're right, and it is all fine, and we are all overthinking it...
Queen's Recruit#172.dst: ……有可能。我希望你是對的，希望一切都沒事，是我們想太多了……
Queen's Recruit#172.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#173.src: But I can't let my guard down. Everything about this situation is screaming that something isn't right, and... I don't know what.
Queen's Recruit#173.dst: 可是我不能鬆懈。這整件事的每一個環節都在喊著哪裡不對勁，而我……我不知道是哪裡。
Queen's Recruit#173.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#174.src: Nothin' wrong with hopin' for the best. Stayin' positive is all ya can really do, sometimes.
Queen's Recruit#174.dst: 抱著最好的期待沒什麼不對。有時候你能做的也就只有保持樂觀了。
Queen's Recruit#174.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#175.src: Out here on the sea, we have a saying... go searchin' for the storm, and it'll find ya itself. Don't expect the worst, or it'll find a way to come to pass.
Queen's Recruit#175.dst: 我們在海上有句話——去找暴風雨，它自己就會找上你。別總是預期最壞的，不然它會想辦法應驗。
Queen's Recruit#175.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#176.src: ... home? Home. I guess. It’ll be nice to have more memories of it than just… you know. Curses and all that.
Queen's Recruit#176.dst: ……老家？老家。算是吧。要是關於它的記憶能多一點，而不是只有……你知道的。詛咒那些事，那也挺好的。
Queen's Recruit#176.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#177.src: Hm. I don’t got much of a home to get back to, either. Had it taken from me by those I trusted, eheh!
Queen's Recruit#177.dst: 嗯。我也沒什麼老家好回了。被我信任的人給奪走啦，嘿嘿！
Queen's Recruit#177.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#178.src: ... But, I made my own home, out here on the sea. Think even if I could go back now, I wouldn’t!
Queen's Recruit#178.dst: ……不過呢，我在這片海上，給自己造了一個家。我想就算現在能回去，我也不會回去了！
Queen's Recruit#178.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#179.src: So, if y’don’t like what ya find... don’t feel forced to take it, y’hear?
Queen's Recruit#179.dst: 所以啊，你要是不喜歡你在那裡看見的東西……別覺得自己非接受不可，聽見沒？
Queen's Recruit#179.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#180.src: ...I'll keep that in mind. Thank you, captain.
Queen's Recruit#180.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#181.src: Ah, it's what I'm here for, ain't it? Givin' sage advice and salin' folks around the sea!
Queen's Recruit#181.dst: 啊，我不就是幹這行的嗎？給人講講大道理，順便把人載過這片海！
Queen's Recruit#181.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#182.src: And look at that, on the horizon! Shinin' opulent docks... seems we've arrived.
Queen's Recruit#182.dst: 你們看，地平線那邊！閃閃發亮的華麗碼頭……看來我們到了。
Queen's Recruit#182.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#183.src: Dunno what you'll be facin' in there... but good luck anyway, aye?
Queen's Recruit#183.dst: 不曉得你們進去要面對什麼……不過還是祝你們好運，好嗎？
Queen's Recruit#183.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#184.src: We'll need it. Thanks for bringing us here, captain.
Queen's Recruit#184.dst: 我們會很需要的。謝謝你送我們過來，船長。
Queen's Recruit#184.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#186.src: It's... impressive. To build something like this for a gate no one ever uses...
Queen's Recruit#186.dst: 這……很壯觀。為了一道根本沒人在用的城門蓋成這樣……
Queen's Recruit#186.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#187.src: I guess they have the resources to spare.
Queen's Recruit#187.dst: 我猜他們是有本錢揮霍吧。
Queen's Recruit#187.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#188.src: Meet up with the group at the gate at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Queen's Recruit#189.src: Finally! The stragglers arrive. You certainly took your time, didn't you?
Queen's Recruit#189.dst: 總算！掉隊的來了。你們可真是不慌不忙啊？
Queen's Recruit#189.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#191.src: Not the time, Kymer. Leave the poor man be for an hour, eh? Got bigger fish to fry, n' all that.
Queen's Recruit#191.dst: 現在不是時候，Kymer。放這可憐人一馬，就一個鐘頭，行嗎？我們還有更要緊的事。
Queen's Recruit#191.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#192.src: Yes, yes, fine. We've not been able to get a word out of any of these soldiers! Do we even have the right time and place?
Queen's Recruit#192.dst: 好啦好啦，行。我們從這些士兵嘴裡連一個字都問不出來！我們到底有沒有搞對時間和地點啊？
Queen's Recruit#192.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#193.src: Nah, you just haven't been trying hard enough. Hey, tin can! This is Fruma, right?
Queen's Recruit#193.dst: 沒有啦，是你不夠拚而已。喂，鐵罐頭！這裡是 Fruma 吧？
Queen's Recruit#193.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#197.src: It really is an impressive construction, isn't it? All this for a closed-off province.
Queen's Recruit#197.dst: 這建築確實很了不起，對吧？一個封閉的行省，居然為此下這種本錢。
Queen's Recruit#197.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#198.src: Impressive or not, we have work to do! On your guard, everyone. We don't know what to expect, so watch your backs.
Queen's Recruit#198.dst: 了不起歸了不起，我們還有正事要辦！各位小心。我們不知道會遇上什麼，看好自己的背後。
Queen's Recruit#198.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#199.src: S'anyone's guess when they'll actually let us in...
Queen's Recruit#199.dst: 天曉得他們什麼時候才肯放我們進去……
Queen's Recruit#199.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#202.src: Soldiers of Wynn! Her Majesty welcomes you to the province, as guests of the crown!
Queen's Recruit#202.dst: Wynn 的士兵們！女王陛下歡迎各位以王室貴賓的身分蒞臨本行省！
Queen's Recruit#202.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#203.src: Follow me, and you will be escorted to the royal palace. Let's not keep her waiting you all are of great importance to her.
Queen's Recruit#203.dst: 請跟我來，我會護送各位前往皇宮。別讓陛下久等——各位對她而言非常重要。
Queen's Recruit#203.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#204.src: Listen to the introduction. Go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to return to the palace.

Queen's Recruit#205.src: Fruma's... a lot bigger than what I saw in my memories...
Queen's Recruit#205.dst: Fruma……比我記憶裡看到的大好多……
Queen's Recruit#205.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#206.src: I guess that makes sense. I probably didn't travel much, back then. But... still.
Queen's Recruit#206.dst: 這也說得通吧。我那時候大概沒怎麼出過遠門。但……還是很震撼。
Queen's Recruit#206.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#208.src: It... was. I don't know what I expected going in, but... it was stunning.
Queen's Recruit#208.dst: 確實……是。我說不上來自己原本預期看到什麼，但……那真的很驚人。
Queen's Recruit#208.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#209.src: Ha! Yeah, you know, I think you're right. It was impressive, but Gavel also has impressive sights.
Queen's Recruit#209.dst: 哈！對，你知道嗎，我覺得你說得對。是很壯觀沒錯，可 Gavel 也有壯觀的景色。
Queen's Recruit#209.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#210.src: But let's not get distracted. The tour felt very... controlled. We were never let out of the carriages, and the Sovereign was keeping a watchful eye on us.
Queen's Recruit#210.dst: 不過我們別分心。那趟導覽感覺很……受控。我們全程都沒被放出馬車，統領也一直盯著我們看。
Queen's Recruit#210.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#211.src: I'm interested in what they're choosing not to show us...
Queen's Recruit#211.dst: 我比較好奇的是他們選擇不給我們看的東西……
Queen's Recruit#211.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#213.dst: 問候各位，Wynn 的士兵們。
Queen's Recruit#213.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#214.src: It is my honor as Queen to facilitate your return to our wonderful province. Though long you have spent away, you will always remain children of Fruma!
Queen's Recruit#214.dst: 能以女王的身分促成各位重返我們美好的行省，是我的榮幸。縱使各位離家已久，你們永遠都是 Fruma 的孩子！
Queen's Recruit#214.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#215.src: Your work to battle against the blight beyond our walls has been of great interest. You have certainly made our province proud.
Queen's Recruit#215.dst: 各位在牆外與那片災厄搏鬥的作為，一直令我們深感興趣。你們確實讓本行省引以為傲。
Queen's Recruit#215.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#216.src: You must have questions on the nature of your summons. All will be revealed but first, allow me to introduce two of my wonderful Sovereigns.
Queen's Recruit#216.dst: 對於這次召見的性質，各位想必滿腹疑問。一切都會揭曉——不過首先，容我介紹兩位優秀的統領。
Queen's Recruit#216.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#217.src: You heard my name, but let me introduce myself. I am
Queen's Recruit#217.dst: 各位已經聽過我的名字，但還是讓我自我介紹一下。我是——
Queen's Recruit#217.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#218.src: Majin of House Thalas, the Morning Star, Sovereign of our fair {p}. It's a pleasure, dear soldiers, to join our Queen for this ceremony!
Queen's Recruit#218.dst: Thalas 家的 Majin，人稱晨星，{p} 的統領。親愛的士兵們，能與我們的女王共同主持這場典禮，實在是我的榮幸！
Queen's Recruit#218.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#220.src: ...Zhiraok Nasin, Sovereign of the {p}. The value of that title should speak for itself.
Queen's Recruit#220.dst: ……Zhiraok Nasin，{p} 的統領。這個頭銜的分量，應該不需要我多說。
Queen's Recruit#220.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#221.src: Thank you, Sovereigns. These two, and the rest, are my council for ruling over our province. Each Sovereign is given governance over their own district, and works to serve the people there.
Queen's Recruit#221.dst: 謝謝兩位統領。這兩位，以及其餘各位統領，是我治理本行省的議會。每位統領各自掌管一個轄區，為當地人民效力。
Queen's Recruit#221.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#222.src: There are others. Though none could attend this event they find themselves occupied with various assignments.
Queen's Recruit#222.dst: 還有其他幾位。只是這次都無法出席——他們手上各有任務在身。
Queen's Recruit#222.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#223.src: Enough of the boring talk! It is time for the welcoming feast!
Queen's Recruit#223.dst: 無趣的場面話就到此為止！接風宴的時間到了！
Queen's Recruit#223.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#224.src: We would like to share a taste of what our province has to deliver. Please find your way to the grand dining hall, situated just behind me.
Queen's Recruit#224.dst: 我們想讓各位嚐嚐本行省拿得出手的東西。請往我身後的大宴會廳移駕。
Queen's Recruit#224.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#225.src: Head to the royal dining hall at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

Queen's Recruit#226.src: Make your way to the dining hall, the Queen will be starting her speech soon.
Queen's Recruit#226.dst: 請前往宴會廳，女王陛下的致詞就快開始了。
Queen's Recruit#226.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#227.src: ...you can't even follow the order of operations while Her Majesty is watching?! What kind of expected value must the recruits ha
Queen's Recruit#227.dst: ……陛下就在旁邊看著，你連運算順序都跟不上？！那新兵的期望值到底要多——
Queen's Recruit#227.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#228.src: Now, now, Nasin, settle down. We wouldn't want to leave a poor impression on our guest, would we?
Queen's Recruit#228.dst: 好了好了，Nasin，冷靜點。我們可不希望在客人面前留下壞印象，是吧？
Queen's Recruit#228.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#229.dst: 別再打斷我的推導了，你這個偽君——
Queen's Recruit#229.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#230.src: Oh, you. You should report to the dining hall with the remainder of your group.
Queen's Recruit#230.dst: 哦，是你。你該去宴會廳跟你其他同伴會合了。
Queen's Recruit#230.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#231.src: Yes, yes, move along. You certainly don't want to keep Her Majesty waiting!
Queen's Recruit#231.dst: 對對對，快走吧。你肯定不會想讓女王陛下等的！
Queen's Recruit#231.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#232.src: Well, I have put it off long enough. Before the first course is served, I will reveal the purpose of your presence here today.
Queen's Recruit#232.dst: 好了，我拖得夠久了。在第一道菜上桌之前，我要揭曉各位今天出現在這裡的目的。
Queen's Recruit#232.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#233.src: In celebration of your work in the Wynn Province, we shall be hosting a tournament! You will all partake in a set of duels in order to crown the greatest soldier among you.
Queen's Recruit#233.dst: 為表彰各位在 Wynn 行省的功績，我們將舉辦一場錦標賽！各位將參與一系列決鬥，選出你們之中最強的士兵。
Queen's Recruit#233.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#234.src: You have all grown in your time spent beyond our walls, and what better way to show it?
Queen's Recruit#234.dst: 各位在牆外的這段歲月都有所成長，還有什麼比這更好的展現方式呢？
Queen's Recruit#234.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#235.src: We will, of course, provide compensation for all participants. A generous monetary reward shall be granted to each of you, no matter your placing in the tournament.
Queen's Recruit#235.dst: 當然，我們會提供所有參賽者報酬。無論名次如何，每一位都能獲得一筆優渥的獎金。
Queen's Recruit#235.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#236.src: However, for whichever of you finds themselves crowned winner... a greater reward awaits. The specifics shall be revealed once the tournament has concluded.
Queen's Recruit#236.dst: 然而，最終奪冠的那一位……還有更豐厚的獎賞在等著。細節將在錦標賽結束後揭曉。
Queen's Recruit#236.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#237.src: Ah, your majesty if I may... I am not much of a fighter my specialty is in research and study of magic.
Queen's Recruit#237.dst: 啊，陛下——容我插一句……我不太擅長打鬥，我的專長在於魔法的研究與探討。
Queen's Recruit#237.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#238.src: ...very well. Accommodations shall be made. A different request may be made of you later, in exchange.
Queen's Recruit#238.dst: ……也好。我們會為你做出安排。作為交換，日後可能會對你提出另一項請求。
Queen's Recruit#238.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#239.src: I thank you for your grace and understanding, your majesty.
Queen's Recruit#239.dst: 感謝陛下的寬容與體諒。
Queen's Recruit#239.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#240.src: Yes... now. Once the meal comes to a close, you shall all be assigned a room to stay in for the remainder of your stay in my palace.
Queen's Recruit#240.dst: 好……那麼。用餐結束後，各位會各自分配到一間房間，在停留於我宮中的期間使用。
Queen's Recruit#240.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#241.src: Ah! It seems the first course has been prepared! Please, enjoy our province's finest cuisine.
Queen's Recruit#241.dst: 啊！看來第一道菜已經備妥了！請盡情享用本行省最上乘的佳餚。
Queen's Recruit#241.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#242.src: ...I can't say I was expecting that, of all things.
Queen's Recruit#242.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#243.src: You'll be joining the tournament, right?
Queen's Recruit#243.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#245.src: We'd better get going and find our rooms everyone else headed south.
Queen's Recruit#245.dst: 我們最好動身去找房間——其他人都往南邊去了。
Queen's Recruit#245.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#246.src: Get your assigned room from the representative at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
Queen's Recruit#246.dst: 到 [-{~1}, {~2}, {~3}] 向接待人員領取分配到的房間。

Queen's Recruit#248.src: Your rooms are located on the east and west side of here.
Queen's Recruit#248.dst: 各位的房間位於這裡的東側與西側。
Queen's Recruit#248.speaker: Aelumia Guard

Queen's Recruit#249.src: Your rooms are on the other side of the castle. Please make your way over there.
Queen's Recruit#249.dst: 各位的房間在城堡的另一側。請往那邊移動。
Queen's Recruit#249.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#254.src: Talk about a fancy feast, huh?
Queen's Recruit#254.dst: 那頓飯還真是排場十足，對吧？
Queen's Recruit#254.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#255.src: They're really pullin' out all the stops, huh? Don't think I've had anythin' that good in a long while.
Queen's Recruit#255.dst: 他們是真的把家底都搬出來了啊？我好久沒吃過那麼好的東西了。
Queen's Recruit#255.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#256.src: Yeah, that was probably the best meal I've had in a long time... Really tired me out. Can't wait for a long and good rest.
Queen's Recruit#256.dst: 是啊，那大概是我這陣子吃過最好的一餐了……害我整個人都累了。真想好好睡一大覺。
Queen's Recruit#256.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#257.src: Ah, there we are. Tasim and {u}, you'll be in room W3... in the western wing.
Queen's Recruit#257.dst: 啊，找到了。Tasim 和 {u}，你們住 W3……在西翼。
Queen's Recruit#257.speaker: Representative

Queen's Recruit#258.src: How 'bout us? I'm Mel, and this is Linton.
Queen's Recruit#258.dst: 那我們呢？我是 Mel，這位是 Linton。
Queen's Recruit#258.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#261.src: Mel and Lanu, you'll be in E2.
Queen's Recruit#261.dst: Mel 和 Lanu，你們住 E2。
Queen's Recruit#261.speaker: Representative

Queen's Recruit#262.src: Uh hey, I think you forgot someone! Where am I staying?
Queen's Recruit#262.dst: 呃——喂，你好像漏了一個人吧？那我住哪？
Queen's Recruit#262.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#265.src: Linton and Kymer are in W2.
Queen's Recruit#265.dst: Linton 和 Kymer 住 W2。
Queen's Recruit#265.speaker: Representative

Queen's Recruit#266.src: Oh... uh, Kymer, huh? That's... hm. Okay.
Queen's Recruit#266.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#268.src: Head to your room, W-{~}, and check it out.
Queen's Recruit#268.dst: 前往你分配到的房間 W-{~}，看看裡面。

Queen's Recruit#269.src: Room W3... Now get going. I have a lot of rooms to assign...
Queen's Recruit#269.dst: W3 號房……好了快走吧。我還有一大堆房間要分。
Queen's Recruit#269.speaker: Representative

Queen's Recruit#270.src: I'm just gonna wait here for Lanu.
Queen's Recruit#270.dst: 我在這等 Lanu 就好。
Queen's Recruit#270.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#271.src: Hm... {u}? Think you've got the wrong room!
Queen's Recruit#271.dst: 嗯……{u}？我看你是走錯房間了吧！
Queen's Recruit#271.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#272.src: Odd that I've got a room all to myself... but eh, I won't complain.
Queen's Recruit#272.dst: 我一個人住一間是有點奇怪……不過欸，我可不會抱怨。
Queen's Recruit#272.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#273.src: Kymer. Sure! Cool, cool cool cool... I can stay with the... big biceps... yep. That's... fine. That's fine. Good, even.
Queen's Recruit#273.dst: 跟 Kymer。當然！酷，酷酷酷……我可以跟那個……大肌肉……嗯。那……沒問題。沒問題的。很好，甚至。
Queen's Recruit#273.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#274.dst: 所以，這就是我們的房間？
Queen's Recruit#274.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#275.src: It seems cozy enough, I guess... hard to relax, though, given... you know. all of it.
Queen's Recruit#275.dst: 還算舒適吧，我想……不過很難放鬆就是了，畢竟……你懂的。這一整件事。
Queen's Recruit#275.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#276.src: ...it's easier than I thought it would be, being in Fruma. There's enough distance from... the, uh, memories.
Queen's Recruit#276.dst: ……待在 Fruma 這件事，比我以為的容易一點。跟那些……呃，那些記憶，隔得夠遠。
Queen's Recruit#276.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#277.src: But, okay, we're in private now. So.. what do you actually think of the tournament? It's weird, right? Why would we be invited for this?
Queen's Recruit#277.dst: 不過，好，現在只有我們了。所以……你對這場錦標賽到底怎麼看？很怪吧？他們為什麼要為了這個把我們請來？
Queen's Recruit#277.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#278.src: Me neither. I don't know what I was expecting when we were entering Fruma, but it wasn't... this.
Queen's Recruit#278.dst: 我也想不通。我說不上進 Fruma 之前我在期待什麼，但絕對不是……這個。
Queen's Recruit#278.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#279.src: I think we'll have to participate, but keep an eye out. Maybe the secret reward will have some answers..
Queen's Recruit#279.dst: 我想我們只能參加，但要留意四周。說不定那個祕密獎賞裡藏著答案。
Queen's Recruit#279.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#280.src: Hm... you're probably right, I just don't know what it could possibly be.
Queen's Recruit#280.dst: 嗯……你大概說得對，我只是想不出那到底會是什麼。
Queen's Recruit#280.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#281.src: Maybe there's something going on with that secret reward for the winner... we'll have to wait and see, I guess.
Queen's Recruit#281.dst: 說不定關鍵就在給冠軍的那個祕密獎賞上……我想我們只能等著看了。
Queen's Recruit#281.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#282.src: Ha! Yeah, alright. I’m a little excited, too. I haven’t had any friendly duels for a long time, so maybe it’ll be nice to test my strength.
Queen's Recruit#282.dst: 哈！好啦，說得也是。我也有點期待。我很久沒跟人友好地過招了，能試試自己的斤兩說不定挺好的。
Queen's Recruit#282.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#283.src: But don’t forget why we’re here. Keep your guard up. Something about that reward she mentioned... it makes me uneasy.
Queen's Recruit#283.dst: 但別忘了我們為什麼在這裡。保持警覺。她提到的那個獎賞……總讓我心裡不踏實。
Queen's Recruit#283.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#284.src: It strikes me as the kind of thing Aledar would enjoy. What better way to prove himself than to win this big tournament?
Queen's Recruit#284.dst: 我覺得那種東西正合 Aledar 的胃口。要證明自己，還有什麼比贏下這種大賽更好的方式？
Queen's Recruit#284.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#285.src: He'd get to use all his potions and tricks, too! He's always telling me about the horrific creations he's mixed together.
Queen's Recruit#285.dst: 而且他還能把他那些藥水和花招全用上！他老是跟我講他調出了什麼恐怖的東西。
Queen's Recruit#285.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#287.dst: 所以，這就是我們的房間？
Queen's Recruit#287.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#288.src: It seems cozy enough, I guess... hard to relax, though, given... you know. all of it.
Queen's Recruit#288.dst: 還算舒適吧，我想……不過很難放鬆就是了，畢竟……你懂的。這一整件事。
Queen's Recruit#288.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#289.src: ...it's easier than I thought it would be, being in Fruma. There's enough distance from... the, uh, memories.
Queen's Recruit#289.dst: ……待在 Fruma 這件事，比我以為的容易一點。跟那些……呃，那些記憶，隔得夠遠。
Queen's Recruit#289.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#290.src: But, okay, we're in private now. So.. what do you actually think of the tournament? It's weird, right? Why would we be invited for this?
Queen's Recruit#290.dst: 不過，好，現在只有我們了。所以……你對這場錦標賽到底怎麼看？很怪吧？他們為什麼要為了這個把我們請來？
Queen's Recruit#290.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#291.src: Me neither. I don't know what I was expecting when we were entering Fruma, but it wasn't... this.
Queen's Recruit#291.dst: 我也想不通。我說不上進 Fruma 之前我在期待什麼，但絕對不是……這個。
Queen's Recruit#291.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#292.src: I think we'll have to participate, but keep an eye out. Maybe the secret reward will have some answers..
Queen's Recruit#292.dst: 我想我們只能參加，但要留意四周。說不定那個祕密獎賞裡藏著答案。
Queen's Recruit#292.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#293.src: Hm... you're probably right, I just don't know what it could possibly be.
Queen's Recruit#293.dst: 嗯……你大概說得對，我只是想不出那到底會是什麼。
Queen's Recruit#293.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#294.src: Maybe there's something going on with that secret reward for the winner... we'll have to wait and see, I guess.
Queen's Recruit#294.dst: 說不定關鍵就在給冠軍的那個祕密獎賞上……我想我們只能等著看了。
Queen's Recruit#294.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#295.src: Ha! Yeah, alright. I’m a little excited, too. I haven’t had any friendly duels for a long time, so maybe it’ll be nice to test my strength.
Queen's Recruit#295.dst: 哈！好啦，說得也是。我也有點期待。我很久沒跟人友好地過招了，能試試自己的斤兩說不定挺好的。
Queen's Recruit#295.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#296.src: But don’t forget why we’re here. Keep your guard up. Something about that reward she mentioned... it makes me uneasy.
Queen's Recruit#296.dst: 但別忘了我們為什麼在這裡。保持警覺。她提到的那個獎賞……總讓我心裡不踏實。
Queen's Recruit#296.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#297.src: It strikes me as the kind of thing Aledar would enjoy. What better way to prove himself than to win this big tournament?
Queen's Recruit#297.dst: 我覺得那種東西正合 Aledar 的胃口。要證明自己，還有什麼比贏下這種大賽更好的方式？
Queen's Recruit#297.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#298.src: He'd get to use all his potions and tricks, too! He's always telling me about the horrific creations he's mixed together.
Queen's Recruit#298.dst: 而且他還能把他那些藥水和花招全用上！他老是跟我講他調出了什麼恐怖的東西。
Queen's Recruit#298.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#303.src: Oh, uh, nothing much. Just a secret meeting. In Jenprest's room that's W1, at the start of the corridor.
Queen's Recruit#303.dst: 哦，呃，沒什麼大事。只是個祕密集會。在 Jenprest 的房間——W1，走廊最前面那間。
Queen's Recruit#303.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#304.src: Picard says we should talk about what we've got so far. He also said to space out people coming to the room so wait a few minutes before stopping by!
Queen's Recruit#304.dst: Picard 說我們該把目前掌握到的東西碰個頭。他還說進房間的人要錯開時間——所以你們等個幾分鐘再過來！
Queen's Recruit#304.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#305.src: I... guess that makes sense. But why are you here, and not
Queen's Recruit#305.dst: 我……好像有道理。可是為什麼是你跑來，而不是——
Queen's Recruit#305.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#306.src: 'Cause I'm fast and stealthy. Gotta run now, I don't want to draw the guards' attention. Remember, room W1!
Queen's Recruit#306.dst: 因為我腳程快又擅長潛行。我得走了，不想引起衛兵注意。記住，W1 號房！
Queen's Recruit#306.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#307.src: ...he's energetic, huh. Okay, let's head over to the meeting. I wonder what the others have noticed.
Queen's Recruit#307.dst: ……他還真是精力充沛。好吧，我們過去開會。不曉得其他人注意到了什麼。
Queen's Recruit#307.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#308.src: Meet up with the others in room W-{~} at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

Queen's Recruit#309.src: Ah, good, they're here. Come in, come in. Quickly now.
Queen's Recruit#309.dst: 啊，好，他們到了。進來、進來。動作快。
Queen's Recruit#309.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#310.src: Are we the last ones in?
Queen's Recruit#310.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#311.src: That y'are. Now, Picard, mind tellin' me what was on your damned mind when you commandeered my room without sayin' a word?!
Queen's Recruit#311.dst: 正是。好了 Picard，能不能告訴我，你一聲不吭就徵用我的房間，腦子裡到底在想什麼？！
Queen's Recruit#311.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#312.src: Ah, eheh, well I suppose it, er, may have slipped the mind... not important! We're under a time constraint!
Queen's Recruit#312.dst: 啊，嘿嘿，這個嘛——我想這件事，呃，可能是一時疏忽……不重要！我們時間有限！
Queen's Recruit#312.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#313.src: We've made it this far, but we'll need to plan our next steps. Firstly, however let us start with what information we have gleaned thus far.
Queen's Recruit#313.dst: 我們走到這一步了，但接下來的行動需要規劃。不過首先——先從我們目前挖到的情報開始。
Queen's Recruit#313.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#314.src: Well, the crown certainly has money to spare! What we've seen thus far seems to rival even the richest of nobility I had the pleasure of working with in {p}.
Queen's Recruit#314.dst: 這個嘛，王室顯然是不缺錢的！我們一路看到的排場，比起我在 {p} 有幸打過交道的那些最闊綽的貴族，都不遑多讓。
Queen's Recruit#314.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#315.src: And the architectrual style... it's unique. I haven't seen anything like it before. I suppose it would make sense, if the province has been closed off for so long...
Queen's Recruit#315.dst: 還有建築風格……很獨特。我從沒見過類似的。不過想想也合理，畢竟這個行省封閉了這麼久……
Queen's Recruit#315.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#316.src: Eh, enough of the unimportant details any of the rest o' you feelin' strange about the tournament? Seems an odd thing to invite us folks back for.
Queen's Recruit#316.dst: 欸，這些不重要的細節先擱著——你們其他人對這場錦標賽，有沒有覺得哪裡怪怪的？把我們這些人叫回來辦這個，實在說不通。
Queen's Recruit#316.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#317.src: I was thinking the same thing. And they're willing to pay all of us for participating, no matter how we do... I don't get why.
Queen's Recruit#317.dst: 我也在想同一件事。而且不管我們打得如何，他們都願意付錢……我不懂為什麼。
Queen's Recruit#317.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#318.src: Hm, well, in truth I am not overly concerned about it
Queen's Recruit#318.dst: 嗯，老實說，我對這件事沒有太過在意——
Queen's Recruit#318.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#319.src: Yes, actually, Picard, what was that back there in the dining hall? You're going to draw attention to yourself by opting out of it?
Queen's Recruit#319.dst: 對了，Picard，你在宴會廳那一手是怎麼回事？你退出比賽，不是等於自己招來注目嗎？
Queen's Recruit#319.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#320.src: Oh, what use is there in placing me in such a combat scenario?! I'll be far more useful outside of that structure, free to look around the palace.
Queen's Recruit#320.dst: 哦，把我丟進那種格鬥場面能有什麼用處？！我在那個架構之外能發揮的價值大得多——可以自由地在宮裡四處看看。
Queen's Recruit#320.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#321.src: And besides, they have me giving them a summary of my research notes, so it's not as though I'm free of it entirely, not to mention
Queen's Recruit#321.dst: 更何況，他們要我交出一份研究筆記的摘要，所以我也不算完全置身事外，更別提——
Queen's Recruit#321.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#322.src: Alright, settle down y'all! Limited time, remember? We've gone off track. They're rich, fancy, and want us fightin' for some reason. What else?
Queen's Recruit#322.dst: 好了都安靜！時間有限，記得吧？我們扯遠了。他們有錢、講排場，而且不知為何要我們互相打。還有呢？
Queen's Recruit#322.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#323.src: ...as I was saying before I was rudely interrupted I don't believe there is much to be gleaned from the tournament just yet. It's a puzzle piece we'll have to connect later.
Queen's Recruit#323.dst: ……如同我在被無禮打斷之前所說——我認為這場錦標賽目前榨不出什麼東西。那是一塊得等以後才能拼上的拼圖。
Queen's Recruit#323.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#324.src: Do we have anything on the Queen and her Sovereigns? It's an interesting governmental structure, but I suppose having a more direct line to the Queen has value for the districts.
Queen's Recruit#324.dst: 我們對女王和她的統領們有掌握到什麼嗎？這種政體結構很有意思，不過我想，對各轄區來說，能直接向女王稟報是有價值的。
Queen's Recruit#324.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#325.src: Well, they're obviously putting on an act. They're definitely hiding something from us, and I don't think any of them are as happy to see us as they say they are.
Queen's Recruit#325.dst: 這個嘛，他們明顯是在演戲。他們一定有事瞞著我們，而且我不覺得他們有任何一個像嘴上說的那樣樂見我們回來。
Queen's Recruit#325.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#326.src: Yes, indeed... we were sent to Wynn as exiles, not as honored soldiers. So why are they pretending otherwise? They called us back here.
Queen's Recruit#326.dst: 沒錯……我們當初被送去 Wynn 是流放，不是什麼榮譽出征。那他們現在裝成這樣是為什麼？是他們把我們召回來的。
Queen's Recruit#326.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#327.src: Ah! Perhaps we're unaware that we've cracked that memory spell? For all they know, we still believe their lies.
Queen's Recruit#327.dst: 啊！說不定他們不曉得我們已經破解了記憶咒？在他們看來，我們可能還相信著那套謊。
Queen's Recruit#327.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#328.src: It'd explain some things, for certain...
Queen's Recruit#328.dst: 這樣確實能解釋一些事……
Queen's Recruit#328.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#329.src: So am I the only one confused by the amount of guards around?
Queen's Recruit#329.dst: 所以只有我覺得這裡的衛兵數量很奇怪嗎？
Queen's Recruit#329.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#330.src: You'd think that nine strangers entering the royal palace would be placed under more watchful eyes.
Queen's Recruit#330.dst: 照理說，九個陌生人進了皇宮，應該被盯得更緊才對吧。
Queen's Recruit#330.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#331.src: Now that you mention it... the only guards I saw on the way to our rooms were by the courtyard exit. There aren't any outside our rooms.
Queen's Recruit#331.dst: 經你這麼一提……我們回房間的路上，只有中庭出口那邊有衛兵。房門外一個也沒有。
Queen's Recruit#331.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#332.src: ...so we don't need to do the whole stealthy thing?
Queen's Recruit#332.dst: ……所以我們根本不用搞那套潛行的？
Queen's Recruit#332.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#334.src: Seems they want us t' feel safe and trusted. They've got to know we'll be talkin' about everything we see, so why not leave a good impression, eh?
Queen's Recruit#334.dst: 看來他們是要我們覺得安全、覺得受信任。他們一定曉得我們回去會把看到的東西全講出來，那何不留個好印象，是吧？
Queen's Recruit#334.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#335.src: Besides, they've got those two Sovereigns lookin' over us. Pretty strong, aren't they? Figure that's enough incentive not to cause trouble.
Queen's Recruit#335.dst: 再說了，他們還有那兩位統領盯著我們。挺強的，不是嗎？我想那份威懾足以讓人不敢生事。
Queen's Recruit#335.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#336.src: Speakin' of the Sovereigns... and the guards by extension anyone else adept at readin' mana? It hardly feels like there's any of it in use at all!
Queen's Recruit#336.dst: 說到統領……還有那些衛兵——你們有誰擅長讀魔力的？我幾乎感覺不到這裡有在用魔力！
Queen's Recruit#336.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#337.src: I was going to bring that up. I haven't seen any mages at all. The closest I've seen is the higher ranked soldiers wielding magical weapons.
Queen's Recruit#337.dst: 我正要提這件事。我一個法師都沒看到。最接近的也只是高階士兵持有魔法武器。
Queen's Recruit#337.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#338.src: I'm not as good with reading mana, but... there's something wrong with the Sovereigns. They've got an incredibly powerful aura surrounding them. It feels... unnatural.
Queen's Recruit#338.dst: 我讀魔力沒那麼在行，但……那幾位統領有問題。他們身上纏著一股強得離譜的氣息。感覺很……不自然。
Queen's Recruit#338.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#339.src: Yes, you're right. They, and the Queen, are the only ones I've seen here who possess innate magical abilities. If anything, all three of them seem closely linked in terms of energy...
Queen's Recruit#339.dst: 對，你說得沒錯。他們，加上女王，是我在這裡見到唯三具備先天魔法能力的人。而且這三個人的能量，彼此之間似乎關聯很深……
Queen's Recruit#339.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#340.src: As interesting as that is, it doesn't leave much for the rest of us to go off of. Doctor, you're the one who organized us here. What are our plans?
Queen's Recruit#340.dst: 這固然有意思，但留給我們其他人能著手的東西不多。博士，把我們召集到這裡的是你。我們的計畫是什麼？
Queen's Recruit#340.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#341.src: Yes, that I am... well, it seems our most promising lead is the Sovereigns. We'll want to focus on them though, do not neglect general information. We still want to know as much about Fruma as possible.
Queen's Recruit#341.dst: 是，我召的……嗯，看來我們最有希望的線索就是那幾位統領。我們要把重心放在他們身上——不過，一般情報也別忽略。我們還是想盡可能弄清楚 Fruma 的一切。
Queen's Recruit#341.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#342.src: We've been running long enough, let's call it a day. Everyone, get some rest, we must be at our best performance tomorrow.
Queen's Recruit#342.dst: 我們拖得夠久了，今天就到這裡。各位好好休息，明天必須拿出最佳狀態。
Queen's Recruit#342.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#343.src: Let us gather here again tomorrow evening for another meeting. Goodnight, everyone.
Queen's Recruit#343.dst: 明天傍晚我們再在這裡碰面，開下一次會。晚安，各位。
Queen's Recruit#343.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#344.src: Make your way back to W-{~} and sleep.
Queen's Recruit#344.dst: 回到 W-{~} 號房睡覺。

Queen's Recruit#345.src: Those Sovereigns... they do concern me. If Fruma's leadership holds this much power, then...
Queen's Recruit#345.dst: 那幾位統領……確實讓我不安。如果 Fruma 的高層握有這種程度的力量，那……
Queen's Recruit#345.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#346.src: Hm. Perhaps our King is right not to get on their bad side.
Queen's Recruit#346.dst: 嗯。或許我們的國王不去招惹他們，是對的。
Queen's Recruit#346.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#347.src: Ah, great, now all o' you are lingerin'. Get out of my room! Not gonna get a lick o' sleep till you're gone...
Queen's Recruit#347.dst: 啊，太好了，現在全都賴在這裡不走了。滾出我的房間！你們不走我一覺都睡不著……
Queen's Recruit#347.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#348.src: ...damned Doctor should'a just used his own room!!
Queen's Recruit#348.dst: ……那個該死的博士就不能用他自己的房間嗎！！
Queen's Recruit#348.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#349.src: ...sigh. What am I doing here? I should have stayed back in {p}.
Queen's Recruit#349.dst: ……唉。我在這裡做什麼？我當初就該留在 {p}。
Queen's Recruit#349.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#350.src: I just hope nobody here knew me before. I'm not sure I could handle that.
Queen's Recruit#350.dst: 我只希望這裡沒有人認識以前的我。那種場面我大概撐不住。
Queen's Recruit#350.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#351.src: Hm... a shame I could not fight in the tournament. A monetary reward would be appreciated, given my dwindling research funds...
Queen's Recruit#351.dst: 嗯……可惜我不能參加錦標賽。我的研究經費快見底了，一筆獎金本來是很受用的……
Queen's Recruit#351.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#352.src: But, alas, I am no fighter. Perhaps the King would be willing to fund my future research...
Queen's Recruit#352.dst: 不過，唉，我終究不是打手。也許國王會願意資助我未來的研究……
Queen's Recruit#352.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#353.src: Gosh, I hope my match tomorrow goes well. I'm a bit nervous... never really dueled anyone before!
Queen's Recruit#353.dst: 天啊，希望我明天那場能順利。我有點緊張……我從來沒跟人正式決鬥過！
Queen's Recruit#353.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#355.src: What? It's been a long day.
Queen's Recruit#355.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#356.src: That magic... why does it feel familiar? I can't pinpoint what it is, but...
Queen's Recruit#356.dst: 那股魔力……為什麼感覺這麼熟悉？我說不出是什麼，但是……
Queen's Recruit#356.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#357.src: Let's just go get some sleep.
Queen's Recruit#357.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#358.src: Goodnight, {u}. I hope you'll sleep better than I will.
Queen's Recruit#358.dst: 晚安，{u}。希望你睡得比我好。
Queen's Recruit#358.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#360.src: {u}! We're going to miss the first round if you sleep any longer!
Queen's Recruit#360.dst: {u}！你再睡下去我們第一輪就要錯過了！
Queen's Recruit#360.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#363.src: Well, I feel your pain. I don't think I got more than an hour or two. I kept... I should have expected it'd be worse here. I just hoped... well, it is what it is.
Queen's Recruit#363.dst: 我懂你的感受。我大概連一兩個小時都沒睡到。我一直……我早該料到在這裡會更難熬的。我只是希望……唉，事情就是這樣。
Queen's Recruit#363.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#364.src: But anyway, it's good you're up. A soldier just came by to tell us to head over to the tournament arena.
Queen's Recruit#364.dst: 總之，你起來就好。剛才有個士兵來通知我們到錦標賽競技場集合。
Queen's Recruit#364.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#365.src: You... no, they just... knocked and slid the notice under the door.
Queen's Recruit#365.dst: 你……不，他們只是……敲了門，把通知從門縫底下塞進來。
Queen's Recruit#365.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#366.src: Was someone in our room during the night...?
Queen's Recruit#366.dst: 昨天晚上有人進過我們房間嗎……？
Queen's Recruit#366.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#367.src: I don't... like... that. Not at all.
Queen's Recruit#367.dst: 我不……喜歡……這樣。一點都不喜歡。
Queen's Recruit#367.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#368.src: Still. We need to head over to the arena. Apparently, it's in the northern part of the palace.
Queen's Recruit#368.dst: 還是得過去。我們得去競技場。聽說是在皇宮北側。
Queen's Recruit#368.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#369.src: Find the location of the tournament in the northern side of the palace at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
Queen's Recruit#369.dst: 到皇宮北側 [-{~1}, {~2}, {~3}] 找到錦標賽的地點。

Queen's Recruit#370.src: Well, well. Looks like we'll finally get to test which o' us is stronger, eh, captain?
Queen's Recruit#370.dst: 哎唷。看來我們總算能驗一驗誰比較強了，是吧，隊長？
Queen's Recruit#370.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#371.src: Oh, finally? I wasn't aware there was even a question! Lieutenant, do you truly think you stand a chance against me?
Queen's Recruit#371.dst: 哦，總算？我還不曉得這件事有什麼好問的呢！中尉，你真以為你在我面前有勝算？
Queen's Recruit#371.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#372.src: Ah, enough o' your posturin', Kymer! You might be all up n' fancy these days, but I still remember when you were but a rookie, all afraid of a lil' old zombie!
Queen's Recruit#372.dst: 啊，少擺你那個架子了，Kymer！你如今是人模人樣沒錯，可我還記得你當菜鳥那會兒，被一隻老殭屍嚇得半死！
Queen's Recruit#372.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#373.src: Ha! Ah, good times. Good times. You'll get your recognition too one of these days, you know. Maybe you'll even surpass my rank someday!
Queen's Recruit#373.dst: 哈！好時光啊。好時光。你總有一天也會得到你該有的表揚的，你知道。說不定哪天還會爬到我頭上呢！
Queen's Recruit#373.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#374.src: Eh, you say that every time. Besides, the lower ranks suit me well. Don't think I'd do well with all that "responsibility" the big wigs put on your shoulders.
Queen's Recruit#374.dst: 欸，你每次都這麼說。再說了，低階挺適合我的。那些大人物往你肩上壓的「責任」，我可扛不太住。
Queen's Recruit#374.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#375.src: ...all that bein' said, you're still goin' down when it's our go! I got some new tricks since the last time we fought, so don't get too cocky!
Queen's Recruit#375.dst: ……話雖如此，輪到我們上場的時候你還是要倒的！上次交手之後我可學了幾招新的，別太得意！
Queen's Recruit#375.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#376.src: Ha! Then I look forward to seeing them.
Queen's Recruit#376.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#377.src: If you're looking for the tournament arena, go down this corridor then turn to the left.
Queen's Recruit#377.dst: 如果你們要找錦標賽競技場，沿這條走廊走到底再左轉。
Queen's Recruit#377.speaker: Aelumia Guard

Queen's Recruit#378.src: The tournament arena is further down the corridor.
Queen's Recruit#378.dst: 錦標賽競技場在走廊再往前一點的地方。
Queen's Recruit#378.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#379.src: This area is unfortunately not accessible at this moment.
Queen's Recruit#379.dst: 很抱歉，這個區域目前不開放。
Queen's Recruit#379.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#380.src: This is Her Majesty's own personal quarter.
Queen's Recruit#380.dst: 這裡是女王陛下的私人寢宮。
Queen's Recruit#380.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#381.src: I'm afraid I can't let you in just yet. Not until
Queen's Recruit#381.dst: 恐怕我還不能放你進去。要等到——
Queen's Recruit#381.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#382.src: Yes, yes, my research notes, I am aware. It has been sorted already. May I visit the library now?
Queen's Recruit#382.dst: 是是是，我的研究筆記，我知道。那件事已經辦妥了。我現在可以去圖書館了嗎？
Queen's Recruit#382.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#383.src: Don't interrupt me. You can't enter until this round of tournament matches concludes. Her Majesty's orders.
Queen's Recruit#383.dst: 別打斷我。這一輪比賽結束之前你不能進去。女王陛下的命令。
Queen's Recruit#383.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#384.src: Pah. Fine! Fine, yes, I'll wait. Good grief.
Queen's Recruit#384.dst: 呸。好吧！好，我等就是了。真是的。
Queen's Recruit#384.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#385.src: You'd think I would have some level of freedom, but no! What does it matter if I don't want to watch the matches if there's nothing else to do?!
Queen's Recruit#385.dst: 你以為我好歹該有點行動自由，結果沒有！要是沒別的事可做，我不想看比賽又有什麼關係？！
Queen's Recruit#385.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#386.src: Oh, just go and get your match over with. Quit stalling.
Queen's Recruit#386.dst: 哦，快去把你那場比完吧。別磨蹭了。
Queen's Recruit#386.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#388.src: Just head down these stairs to find the tournament arena.
Queen's Recruit#388.dst: 順著這道樓梯下去就是錦標賽競技場。
Queen's Recruit#388.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#389.src: The match ups will be announced once everyone is present.
Queen's Recruit#389.dst: 人到齊之後就會公布對戰組合。
Queen's Recruit#389.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#390.src: Uh. Sovereign... Majin? Sovereign Majin. We're all here.
Queen's Recruit#390.dst: 呃。統領……Majin？Majin 統領。我們都到了。
Queen's Recruit#390.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#391.src: My, it's about time! As guests of the crown, it would do you well to arrive on time for such things, hm? Tardiness is not a good look.
Queen's Recruit#391.dst: 哎呀，總算來了！身為王室的貴賓，這種場合準時到場對各位有好處，嗯？遲到可不好看。
Queen's Recruit#391.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#392.src: Our apologies, Sovereign. It would seem we were not given the time to be here in advance a humble mistake, I'm certain.
Queen's Recruit#392.dst: 我們深感抱歉，統領大人。看來是我們沒被留下提早抵達的時間——想必只是個無心之失。
Queen's Recruit#392.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#393.src: Ah, the incompetence of our lessers... it never ceases to amaze! Nevertheless, the duty of arriving on schedule remains on your shoulders. Do better next time, would you?
Queen's Recruit#393.dst: 啊，下等人的無能……真是令人嘆為觀止！儘管如此，準時到場的責任依然在各位肩上。下次做好一點，好嗎？
Queen's Recruit#393.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#394.src: Now, I am a very busy man, so I will keep this brief. As Her Majesty has already explained, this tournament will consist of multiple duels! You are not required to watch each match.
Queen's Recruit#394.dst: 好了，我是個大忙人，所以我長話短說。誠如女王陛下已經說明過的，這場錦標賽將由多場決鬥組成！各位不必每一場都到場觀看。
Queen's Recruit#394.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#395.src: The standard rules apply. No killing, no maiming, no attacking anyone outside the arena though, do try, I'd find much pleasure in watching you fail!
Queen's Recruit#395.dst: 規則照舊。不得殺害、不得致殘、不得攻擊場外人員——不過歡迎嘗試，我很樂意看各位失敗。
Queen's Recruit#395.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#396.src: With that settled, are there any questions? I would certainly hope not, I have much to return to once this is
Queen's Recruit#396.dst: 那麼，還有任何問題嗎？我當然希望沒有，這件事一了我還有一大堆事要——
Queen's Recruit#396.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#397.src: Ah, I do I am not participating in the tournament. I had been told to expect some alternative today.
Queen's Recruit#397.dst: 啊，我有——我不參加錦標賽。有人告訴我今天會為我安排別的事。
Queen's Recruit#397.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#398.src: Oh, yes... you. What did you say you were again, a... researcher?
Queen's Recruit#398.dst: 哦，對……你啊。你剛才說你是什麼來著，一個……研究員？
Queen's Recruit#398.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#399.src: Ahahaha! Oh, and they selected you as one of your province's greatest? Don't make me laugh! Ahahahahaha!
Queen's Recruit#399.dst: 啊哈哈哈！哦，而他們居然把你選為貴省最傑出的人之一？別逗我笑了！啊哈哈哈哈！
Queen's Recruit#399.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#400.src: Ah, but it's just as well, I suppose. Nine certainly doesn't fit cleanly for such a tournament. Better a researcher than a ninth fighter!
Queen's Recruit#400.dst: 啊，不過這樣也好，我想。九這個數字辦這種錦標賽本來就不乾淨。與其多一個第九名鬥士，不如換個研究員！
Queen's Recruit#400.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#401.src: Yes, someone will be with you shortly. Just sit on the sidelines and twiddle your thumbs, or whatever you do you certainly aren't my problem anymore.
Queen's Recruit#401.dst: 是的，很快就會有人來找你。你就坐在場邊玩你的手指，或隨便你做什麼——反正你已經不是我的問題了。
Queen's Recruit#401.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#404.src: Excellent! The first match up appears to be... {u} and Mel. Step forward, the two of you.
Queen's Recruit#404.dst: 很好！第一場對戰似乎是……{u} 對 Mel。你們兩位，出列。
Queen's Recruit#404.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#407.src: Well, hurry up now, get prepared! Choose a corridor each, north or south, and get to fighting already!
Queen's Recruit#407.dst: 好了，快去準備！各挑一條通道，北邊或南邊，然後給我開打！
Queen's Recruit#407.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#408.src: As for the rest of you... oh, I can't be bothered. Read your matchups on the board yourselves.
Queen's Recruit#408.dst: 至於其他人……哦，我懶得管了。自己去看板上找你們的對戰組合。
Queen's Recruit#408.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#409.src: Uh... alrighty then. I guess I'll choose this one.
Queen's Recruit#409.dst: 呃……好喔。那我選這邊好了。
Queen's Recruit#409.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#410.src: Begin your fight against Mel in the southern waiting room.
Queen's Recruit#410.dst: 到南側候戰室開始與 Mel 的對戰。

Queen's Recruit#412.src: Just 'cause we've got a mission here, doesn't mean I'll go easy on ya!
Queen's Recruit#412.dst: 我們是有任務在身沒錯，可別以為我會放水！
Queen's Recruit#412.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#413.src: Ready to go?! Let's show them what we're made of!
Queen's Recruit#413.dst: 準備好了嗎？！讓他們看看我們的本事！
Queen's Recruit#413.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#414.src: Phew! What a fight! Got my blood rushin'!
Queen's Recruit#414.dst: 呼！打得真過癮！血都熱起來了！
Queen's Recruit#414.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#415.src: What'd you think of my trick? Pretty good, right? Makes me less of a sittin' duck in combat!
Queen's Recruit#415.dst: 你覺得我那招怎麼樣？不賴吧？有了它我在場上就不會只能挨打了！
Queen's Recruit#415.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#416.src: Ah, I didn't think I was gonna be winnin' anything, really. But it was fun givin' it a shot.
Queen's Recruit#416.dst: 啊，我本來也沒指望能贏什麼啦。不過試一試還挺好玩的。
Queen's Recruit#416.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#417.src: {u} has bested Mel in the first round, and will progress to the next!
Queen's Recruit#417.dst: {u} 在第一輪擊敗 Mel，晉級下一輪！
Queen's Recruit#417.speaker: Aelumia Guard

Queen's Recruit#419.src: You will be permitted to remain in the palace for the duration of the tournament. You will be paid for your participation at the end of your stay.
Queen's Recruit#419.dst: 錦標賽期間你仍可留在宮中。參賽報酬會在你離開時發放。
Queen's Recruit#419.speaker: Aelumia Guard

Queen's Recruit#420.src: I figure that makes sense. I wonder when Lanu's match is...
Queen's Recruit#420.dst: 我想這也合理。不曉得 Lanu 的比賽是什麼時候……
Queen's Recruit#420.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#421.src: {u}, congratulations on your victory. You will be notified when your next match is. In the meantime, feel free to rest.
Queen's Recruit#421.dst: {u}，恭喜獲勝。下一場比賽的時間會另行通知。在那之前，請自便休息。
Queen's Recruit#421.speaker: Aelumia Guard

Queen's Recruit#422.src: Leave the arena waiting room and find Picard at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
Queen's Recruit#422.dst: 離開競技場候戰室，到 [-{~1}, {~2}, {~3}] 找 Picard。

Queen's Recruit#423.src: It was a good fight! But you'd better win in my honor now, y'hear?
Queen's Recruit#423.dst: 那是一場好比賽！不過你現在可得為我的面子贏下去，聽見沒？
Queen's Recruit#423.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#424.src: We will announce your next match later. Please feel free to rest or enjoy the palace in the meantime.
Queen's Recruit#424.dst: 下一場對戰稍後公布。在那之前，請自便休息或參觀皇宮。
Queen's Recruit#424.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#425.src: Ah, {u}, I saw the match! Very good technique, better than many soldiers I've seen pass through {p} in my time.
Queen's Recruit#425.dst: 啊，{u}，我看了你那場！技術非常好，比我在 {p} 那些年見過的許多士兵都強。
Queen's Recruit#425.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#426.src: I suppose I'm not surprised! When the tournament was announced, you came to mind as a potential winner. You, and one other person, that is.
Queen's Recruit#426.dst: 我想這也不意外！錦標賽公布的時候，我心裡浮現的可能冠軍就是你。你，還有另外一個人。
Queen's Recruit#426.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#427.src: Hm... maybe I could start taking bets on who will win... ah, no, no, I'm far too busy. Stay focused, Picard.
Queen's Recruit#427.dst: 嗯……說不定我可以開個賭盤押誰會贏……啊，不行不行，我太忙了。專心點，Picard。
Queen's Recruit#427.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#428.src: Hm? Oh dear, I'd forgotten you were here! Yes, I was going to do something...
Queen's Recruit#428.dst: 嗯？哎呀，我都忘了你還在這！對，我本來要去做一件事……
Queen's Recruit#428.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#429.src: Oh! The library! Can you believe it, that damnable guard finally stepped away! It's ridiculous, really who even cares to guard a library of all things?!
Queen's Recruit#429.dst: 哦！圖書館！你敢相信嗎，那個討人厭的衛兵終於走開了！這也太荒謬了——圖書館到底有什麼好守的？！
Queen's Recruit#429.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#430.src: But. But but but. The way is open, and although the tournament round is still ongoing, I'd like to take the opportunity while I can!
Queen's Recruit#430.dst: 但是。但是但是但是。路開了，雖然這一輪比賽還沒結束，我還是想趁機會還在的時候把握住！
Queen's Recruit#430.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#431.src: Care to join me? I'm sure there's something you'll find interesting in there. What sorts of knowledge have the Frumans kept hidden in these walls...
Queen's Recruit#431.dst: 要一起來嗎？我相信裡面一定有你會感興趣的東西。Fruma 人在這些牆裡藏了什麼樣的知識呢……
Queen's Recruit#431.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#432.src: Well, are you coming? Come now, quickly, before the guard returns!
Queen's Recruit#432.dst: 你到底來不來？快點快點，趁衛兵回來之前！
Queen's Recruit#432.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#433.dst: 跟著 Picard 進入圖書館。

Queen's Recruit#434.src: Goodness, where even to begin? There's so much here...
Queen's Recruit#434.dst: 天啊，該從哪裡開始才好？這裡的東西也太多了……
Queen's Recruit#434.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#435.src: ...and that we're rifling through the Cursed instead of our own citizens is an incalculable risk!
Queen's Recruit#435.dst: ……而我們翻的是那些受詛者、而不是我們自己的國民，這是個算不出來的風險！

Queen's Recruit#436.src: What was that?! Quickly, quickly now, follow me!
Queen's Recruit#436.dst: 那是什麼聲音？！快、快跟我來！
Queen's Recruit#436.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#437.src: Do you have eyes on the speaker? Who is it?
Queen's Recruit#437.dst: 你看得到說話的人嗎？是誰？
Queen's Recruit#437.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#438.src: I can't find her angle for this hunt.
Queen's Recruit#438.dst: 我算不出她這場狩獵的角度。
Queen's Recruit#438.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#439.src: Ah, it's like I'm talking with her again! It's so nostalgic to speak with a clueless Nasin trying their hardest, in spite of their incompe
Queen's Recruit#439.dst: 啊，簡直像在跟她本人說話一樣！看著一個一無所知的 Nasin 拚了命想跟上，卻依然無能——真是令人懷念——
Queen's Recruit#439.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#440.src: I'M SORRY, YOU IGNORANT INTEGRAND? You really think now is the time for Rrgh... Why. Do I even bother.
Queen's Recruit#440.dst: 你說什麼，你這個無知的被積函數？你真以為現在是——嘖……我到底何必呢。
Queen's Recruit#440.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#441.src: Why, indeed! It truly is a bad habit. Something to work on while your seniors do the important work, hm?
Queen's Recruit#441.dst: 是啊，何必呢！這確實是個壞習慣。趁前輩們在辦正事的時候，好好改一改吧，嗯？
Queen's Recruit#441.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#442.src: Speaking of, I must put forth that I do find this all a bit strange. We most certainly aren't lacking in strength here, so why bother with the exiles?
Queen's Recruit#442.dst: 說到這個，我不得不說，這整件事我確實覺得有點蹊蹺。我們這裡明明不缺戰力，何必找那些流放者？
Queen's Recruit#442.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#443.src: ...sigh... The risk factor is much greater than I'd bet on. She has to know more than we do, so maybe we'll get a summation later.
Queen's Recruit#443.dst: ……唉……風險因子比我押的高出太多。她知道的一定比我們多，也許之後我們會拿到一份總和。
Queen's Recruit#443.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#445.src: Ah, there she is. Fashionably late as always!
Queen's Recruit#445.dst: 啊，她來了。一如往常，姍姍來遲得恰到好處！
Queen's Recruit#445.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#446.src: Hm. If anything, I was early.
Queen's Recruit#446.dst: 哼。要說的話，我還早到了。

Queen's Recruit#447.src: I'd say your timing was golden if you're here for that summation I mentioned, and this isn't anything else.
Queen's Recruit#447.dst: 要是你是為了我剛才說的那份總和而來、而不是別的事，那我會說你這時機抓得很黃金比例。
Queen's Recruit#447.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#448.src: It's the former. But first, have you been watching the battles? Do any of the contestants stick out to you?
Queen's Recruit#448.dst: 是前者。不過先說——你們有在看那些比賽嗎？有哪個參賽者讓你們特別留意的？

Queen's Recruit#449.src: Stick out? Hardly. Thus far, I have been thoroughly unimpressed.
Queen's Recruit#449.dst: 特別留意？談不上。到目前為止，我一個都看不上眼。
Queen's Recruit#449.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#450.src: Naturally you would be. I've seen some generally promising things, but I need to know the expected solution to narrow the pool
Queen's Recruit#450.dst: 你當然看不上。我倒是看到幾個大致有潛力的，但我得知道期望解是什麼，才能把範圍縮小——
Queen's Recruit#450.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#451.src: Ah, ah! Settle down, Nasin, your betters are speaking. Calculate yourself out of dead last, first.
Queen's Recruit#451.dst: 啊、啊！稍安勿躁，Nasin，長輩在說話。先把自己從倒數第一算出來再說吧。
Queen's Recruit#451.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#452.src: Later, then. We have problems. The contestants have been sneaking around. And the doctor has been taking meticulous notes.
Queen's Recruit#452.dst: 這事晚點再說。我們有麻煩了。那些參賽者一直在四處打探。而那位博士一直在做非常細密的筆記。

Queen's Recruit#453.src: ...looks like you letting him sit out the problem was a miscalculation, huh?
Queen's Recruit#453.dst: ……看來你讓他退出這道題，是一次誤算囉？
Queen's Recruit#453.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#454.src: For once, we appear to be in agreement. What a pity, what a hassle... it hardly seems worth the effort to me.
Queen's Recruit#454.dst: 難得一次，我們的看法居然一致。真可惜、真麻煩……我實在覺得不值得費這個力氣。
Queen's Recruit#454.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#455.src: It will be. But I've spent too much time here already. You'll have to wait for answers.
Queen's Recruit#455.dst: 值得的。不過我在這裡待太久了。答案你們得再等等。

Queen's Recruit#456.src: Of course. How much more irrational can we get, I wonder.
Queen's Recruit#456.dst: 當然。我倒想看看我們還能有多無理。
Queen's Recruit#456.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#457.src: If you'd like something to look out for, one of the more promising candidates is set to have a match soon. Go watch it.
Queen's Recruit#457.dst: 如果你們想找點東西留意，其中一位比較有希望的人選很快就有一場比賽。去看看吧。

Queen's Recruit#458.src: A joy as always. Well, you heard her, Nasin! Chop chop, off to the stands we go!
Queen's Recruit#458.dst: 一如既往地愉快。好啦，你也聽見她說的了，Nasin！快快快，我們上看台去！
Queen's Recruit#458.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#459.src: ...so not even the Sovereigns know what's happening. Fascinating. Very fascinating.
Queen's Recruit#459.dst: ……所以連統領們都不曉得到底在發生什麼事。有意思。非常有意思。
Queen's Recruit#459.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#460.src: And there was a third! Who were they? Another Sovereign...? Damn it, damn it all, how did I not notice?
Queen's Recruit#460.dst: 而且還有第三個人！那是誰？另一位統領……？可惡、真是可惡，我怎麼會沒注意到？
Queen's Recruit#460.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#461.src: Well, they appear to be onto us. No matter. We'll need to be more careful.
Queen's Recruit#461.dst: 看來他們是盯上我們了。無妨。我們往後得更小心。
Queen's Recruit#461.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#462.src: You'd best get back to the arena. In the meantime, I'll keep searching here... there must be something useful!
Queen's Recruit#462.dst: 你最好回競技場去。我這邊會繼續找……這裡一定有什麼有用的東西！
Queen's Recruit#462.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#464.src: ...hm? Oh, yes, fine, I'll tell the rest about what we heard. After I'm done here, of course.
Queen's Recruit#464.dst: ……嗯？哦，好、好，我會把我們聽到的告訴其他人。當然是等我這邊忙完之後。
Queen's Recruit#464.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#465.src: The first round of the tournament has concluded!
Queen's Recruit#465.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#466.src: The names that will proceed to the next round... {u}! Tasim! Reynauld! Kymer!
Queen's Recruit#466.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#467.src: {u}, your match will begin shortly. Your opponent is already in the waiting room.
Queen's Recruit#467.dst: {u}，你的比賽即將開始。你的對手已經在候戰室了。
Queen's Recruit#467.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#468.src: Make your way to the arena.
Queen's Recruit#468.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#469.src: Begin your next duel in the arena down the stairs.
Queen's Recruit#469.dst: 下樓到競技場開始下一場決鬥。

Queen's Recruit#470.src: Please make your way to the arena by following the stairs down.
Queen's Recruit#470.dst: 請順著樓梯往下前往競技場。
Queen's Recruit#470.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#471.src: Please go to the waiting room and prepare for the battle.
Queen's Recruit#471.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#473.src: Well, you'll likely prove more of a challenge than Linton, that's for sure.
Queen's Recruit#473.dst: 這樣的話，你應該會比 Linton 難纏多了，那是肯定的。
Queen's Recruit#473.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#474.src: You've come a long way since {p}, haven't you? Well, so have I! Let's battle.
Queen's Recruit#474.dst: 從 {p} 那時候到現在，你進步了不少吧？嗯，我也一樣！來打一場吧。
Queen's Recruit#474.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#475.src: The battle is decided! {u} has come out victorious.
Queen's Recruit#475.speaker: Aelumia Guard

Queen's Recruit#476.src: Ah... good fighting, {u}. I even used some of my most powerful arrows.
Queen's Recruit#476.dst: 啊……打得好，{u}。我連最強的幾支箭都用上了。
Queen's Recruit#476.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#478.src: I know, I know. You were a worthy opponent, {u}. Now, you'll be winning this whole thing, yes?
Queen's Recruit#478.dst: 我知道，我知道。你是個值得敬重的對手，{u}。那麼，接下來你會把整場都贏下來吧？
Queen's Recruit#478.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#479.src: {u}, congratulations on reaching the finals. All other opponents have been defeated, except for you and your fellow finalist.
Queen's Recruit#479.dst: {u}，恭喜你晉級決賽。除了你和另一位決賽選手之外，其餘對手都已落敗。
Queen's Recruit#479.speaker: Aelumia Guard

Queen's Recruit#480.src: Hmph. That will be announced shortly. Please make your way to the courtyard and await further instructions.
Queen's Recruit#480.dst: 哼。那個稍後會公布。請前往中庭等候進一步指示。
Queen's Recruit#480.speaker: Aelumia Guard

Queen's Recruit#481.src: Return to the courtyard at [-{~}, {~}, {~}] and find other contestants.

Queen's Recruit#482.src: I did well enough, I suppose. I'll be glad for this to all be over, anyway.
Queen's Recruit#482.dst: 我想我表現得還算可以。反正這一切能早點結束我就謝天謝地了。
Queen's Recruit#482.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#483.src: Please make your way to the courtyard and await further instructions.
Queen's Recruit#483.dst: 請前往中庭等候進一步指示。
Queen's Recruit#483.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#484.src: {u}, you return! Well, how did your match go?
Queen's Recruit#484.dst: {u}，你回來了！怎麼樣，你那場打得如何？
Queen's Recruit#484.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#485.src: You? I suppose that would make sense. No offense intended, Reynauld, but I would have bet on {u} if I had the chance.
Queen's Recruit#485.dst: 你？我想這也說得通。無意冒犯，Reynauld，但要是有機會下注，我會押 {u}。
Queen's Recruit#485.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#486.src: Ha. For me, certainly! It felt like I could barely make a dent in your stamina.
Queen's Recruit#486.dst: 哈。對我來說當然是難纏！我感覺我根本削不動你的體力。
Queen's Recruit#486.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#487.src: Yes, yes, congratulations are in order, and all that we have problems.
Queen's Recruit#487.dst: 是是是，該恭喜的都恭喜過了，諸如此類——我們有麻煩了。
Queen's Recruit#487.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#488.src: It was problem enough that he was called here in the first place... to think, he could
Queen's Recruit#488.dst: 他一開始會被叫來這裡就已經夠麻煩了……想想看，他可能會——
Queen's Recruit#488.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#489.src: That's enough about the tournament. I don't want to hear about it anymore. The doctor is right.
Queen's Recruit#489.dst: 錦標賽的事就到此為止。我不想再聽了。博士說得對。
Queen's Recruit#489.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#490.src: Yes, well, it's not your honour on the line... but fine, I admit, this third Sovereign is... troubling.
Queen's Recruit#490.dst: 是啦，反正賭上的又不是你的名譽……不過好吧，我承認，這第三位統領確實……令人不安。
Queen's Recruit#490.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#491.src: Hm. Have we been able to find the information we needed?
Queen's Recruit#491.dst: 嗯。我們有沒有找到需要的情報？
Queen's Recruit#491.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#492.src: No! And that is precisely our problem we are missing something, and we are running out of time! One final match, and then it's done.
Queen's Recruit#492.dst: 沒有！而這正是我們的麻煩所在——我們漏了什麼，而且我們時間快用完了！剩最後一場，然後就結束了。
Queen's Recruit#492.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#493.src: ...truthfully, I'm surprised you were on my side for that match.
Queen's Recruit#493.dst: ……老實說，那場比賽你站在我這邊，我還挺意外的。
Queen's Recruit#493.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#494.src: Ah, well, someone had t' take him down a peg! Guess that someone was you.
Queen's Recruit#494.dst: 欸，總得有人殺殺他的威風嘛！看來那個人就是你了。
Queen's Recruit#494.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#495.src: Oh, give me a break, lieutenant. Him? Of all people to
Queen's Recruit#495.dst: 哦，饒了我吧，中尉。他？在所有人裡面偏偏是——
Queen's Recruit#495.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#496.src: Hey, everyone's here! Is... this where they wanted everyone to gather up?
Queen's Recruit#496.dst: 嘿，大家都在！這裡……就是他們要大家集合的地方嗎？
Queen's Recruit#496.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#497.src: Seems that way. You won your match?
Queen's Recruit#497.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#498.src: I did. It seems I'm a finalist now. So, who's the other one?
Queen's Recruit#498.dst: 贏了。看來我進決賽了。那另一個是誰？
Queen's Recruit#498.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#499.src: Oh! Well, congratulations! Though, I guess we'll be facing each other soon.
Queen's Recruit#499.dst: 哦！那，恭喜！不過，我想我們很快就要對上了。
Queen's Recruit#499.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#500.src: Good grief... yes, the tournament has happened, congratulations to the finalists, whatever where are Mel and Linton? We need to discuss what's next, before
Queen's Recruit#500.dst: 真是的……好、好，錦標賽辦完了，恭喜兩位決賽選手，隨便啦——Mel 和 Linton 人呢？我們得討論接下來怎麼辦，趁——
Queen's Recruit#500.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#501.src: ...and so, what, I'm not allowed to take a nap now? I wasn't even fighting!! Mel, back me up, come on!
Queen's Recruit#501.dst: ……所以說，我現在連睡個午覺都不行了？我根本沒有比賽！！Mel，幫我說句話，拜託！
Queen's Recruit#501.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#502.src: He's right, this hardly seems fair! We were told we could stay in our rooms until the tournament had concluded, so why the change?!
Queen's Recruit#502.dst: 他說得對，這實在不太公道！他們說我們在錦標賽結束前都可以待在房間裡，那怎麼說變就變？！
Queen's Recruit#502.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#504.src: Any competitors who have lost in the tournament are to be escorted out of Fruma, effective immediately.
Queen's Recruit#504.dst: 所有在錦標賽中落敗的參賽者，即刻起將被護送離開 Fruma。
Queen's Recruit#504.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Queen's Recruit#505.src: what is the meaning of this?!
Queen's Recruit#505.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#506.src: SILENCE! These are new orders from Her Majesty.
Queen's Recruit#506.dst: 肅靜！這是女王陛下新下的命令。
Queen's Recruit#506.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Queen's Recruit#507.src: Only {u} and Tasim are permitted to remain in the palace. Any defiance will be seen as an official threat against Fruma from the Wynn province.
Queen's Recruit#507.dst: 只有 {u} 和 Tasim 獲准留在宮中。任何違抗行為，都將被視為 Wynn 行省對 Fruma 的正式威脅。
Queen's Recruit#507.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Queen's Recruit#508.src: Comply, and no one will be hurt. You will still receive your promised reward for participation.
Queen's Recruit#508.dst: 配合行事，就不會有人受傷。你們仍會領到承諾的參賽報酬。
Queen's Recruit#508.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Queen's Recruit#510.src: Enough, Kymer. What's done is done. We have no choice.
Queen's Recruit#510.dst: 夠了，Kymer。木已成舟。我們沒有選擇。
Queen's Recruit#510.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#512.src: You two. Stay safe, and be on guard. I'll report back to the King with this news. If you're not released safely...
Queen's Recruit#512.dst: 你們兩個。保重，小心提防。我會把這個消息回報給國王。要是你們沒能平安獲釋……
Queen's Recruit#512.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#513.src: ...{u}. Tasim. I've gotten what I came here for originally, but... I don't know what they're planning. You'll have to handle it on your own.
Queen's Recruit#513.dst: ……{u}。Tasim。我此行原本的目的已經達成了，可是……我不知道他們在盤算什麼。接下來你們只能靠自己了。
Queen's Recruit#513.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#515.src: Remaining finalists, you are expected in the dining hall shortly. Attend your last meal before the finals.
Queen's Recruit#515.dst: 留下的決賽選手，請盡快到宴會廳。決賽前的最後一餐，請出席。
Queen's Recruit#515.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Queen's Recruit#517.src: What was that? What just happened?
Queen's Recruit#517.dst: 那是怎麼回事？剛才發生了什麼？
Queen's Recruit#517.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#518.src: They've changed the rules on us, and now... ugh, we have no choice... We need to see it through.
Queen's Recruit#518.dst: 他們把規則改掉了，而現在……唉，我們沒有選擇……只能走完這一程。
Queen's Recruit#518.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#519.src: Well... come on. Let's attend our final dinner here.
Queen's Recruit#519.dst: 好吧……走吧。去吃我們在這裡的最後一頓晚餐。
Queen's Recruit#519.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#521.src: What are we supposed to do...?
Queen's Recruit#521.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#522.src: They'll let us out. They have to. It'd be a diplomatic disaster if they didn't.
Queen's Recruit#522.dst: 他們會放我們走的。他們必須放。不放的話會是一場外交災難。
Queen's Recruit#522.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#524.src: If you were not already aware, your fellow soldiers have been returned to Wynn. Safely.
Queen's Recruit#524.dst: 若各位還不知情——你們的同伴已經被送回 Wynn 了。平安無事。
Queen's Recruit#524.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#525.src: ...if you don't mind me asking, Your Majesty, I thought we had an agreement? We would all remain here until the tournament concluded with the finals.
Queen's Recruit#525.dst: ……恕我冒昧，陛下，我以為我們有過約定？在錦標賽以決賽收場之前，我們所有人都可以留在這裡。
Queen's Recruit#525.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#526.src: Oh? And would you like to join the rest of them? That could certainly be arranged we could simply select a victor here and now, and be done with this whole
Queen's Recruit#526.dst: 哦？那你想跟他們一起走嗎？這當然可以安排——我們大可現在就當場選出一位優勝者，把這整件事——
Queen's Recruit#526.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#527.src: What is your problem, Thalas?! They're guests of Her Majesty! How irrational are you, trying to subtract them without her appr
Queen's Recruit#527.dst: 你到底有什麼毛病，Thalas？！他們是女王陛下的客人！你未經她首肯就想把他們減掉，這有多不合理——
Queen's Recruit#527.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#529.src: To answer your question, the circumstances have changed. There is no need for the rest of your group to remain here.
Queen's Recruit#529.dst: 回答你的問題——情況有變。你們其餘同伴已無留下的必要。
Queen's Recruit#529.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#530.src: The remainder of the tournament will proceed as expected.
Queen's Recruit#530.dst: 錦標賽剩下的部分將照原定進行。
Queen's Recruit#530.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#532.src: Good. Now, let us enjoy the meal!
Queen's Recruit#532.dst: 很好。那麼，讓我們好好享用這一餐吧！
Queen's Recruit#532.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#533.src: Another taste of Fruman cuisine... the meat was imported the {p}, and the vegetables came from the royal garden.
Queen's Recruit#533.dst: 再嚐一次 Fruma 的菜色……肉品是從 {p} 進口的，蔬菜則出自皇家花園。
Queen's Recruit#533.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#534.src: Now, to business. The final will take place tomorrow morning. But first, I would like to speak to each of you individually.
Queen's Recruit#534.dst: 好了，說正事。決賽將在明天早上舉行。但在那之前，我想單獨與你們各談一次。
Queen's Recruit#534.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#535.src: Let us begin with... {u}. Please come to the north-eastern wing when you are ready.
Queen's Recruit#535.dst: 就從……{u} 開始吧。準備好了就到東北翼來。
Queen's Recruit#535.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#537.src: Talk to Her Majesty in the north-eastern wing of the palace at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
Queen's Recruit#537.dst: 到皇宮東北翼 [-{~1}, {~2}, {~3}] 與女王陛下談話。

Queen's Recruit#540.src: Well. I suppose congratulations are in order, finalist.
Queen's Recruit#540.dst: 好。我想，是該恭喜你了，決賽選手。
Queen's Recruit#540.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#541.src: You're curious, surely? For what purpose would I call you soldiers back to our province?
Queen's Recruit#541.dst: 你很好奇吧？我究竟為了什麼目的，把你們這些士兵召回本行省？
Queen's Recruit#541.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#542.src: Certainly not for a vanity tournament. A meaningless celebration.
Queen's Recruit#542.dst: 當然不會是為了一場虛榮的錦標賽。一場毫無意義的慶典。
Queen's Recruit#542.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#543.src: Oh, let us drop the facade. I know what you have been doing in secret. I am not blind.
Queen's Recruit#543.dst: 哦，別再演了。你們私下在做什麼，我一清二楚。我不瞎。
Queen's Recruit#543.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#544.src: You chose this opportunity to seek out information on our province. What little you have learned, we have deemed an acceptable cost.
Queen's Recruit#544.dst: 你們選擇利用這次機會，來刺探本行省的情報。你們所學到的那一點皮毛，我們判定是可以接受的代價。
Queen's Recruit#544.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#545.src: Given the circumstances, I would have sacrificed much, much more if necessary.
Queen's Recruit#545.dst: 以眼下的情勢而言，必要的話，我願意犧牲的遠遠不止於此。
Queen's Recruit#545.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#546.src: The greatest that Wynn has... a broad category. We had to thin the numbers a contest of strength did the job nicely.
Queen's Recruit#546.dst: Wynn 最傑出的人物——這個範圍太寬了。我們必須把人數篩下來——一場實力的較量，正好辦到了這件事。
Queen's Recruit#546.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#547.src: And now... two candidates remain. You have done well to make it this far. I have been watching the duels intently, and you are certainly not unimpressive.
Queen's Recruit#547.dst: 而如今……只剩兩位人選。你能走到這一步，表現得很好。我一直專注地看著那些決鬥，你確實不算平庸。
Queen's Recruit#547.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#548.src: Yet of the two of you... you certainly leave a lesser impression than him. You are one amongst hundreds, thousands... indistinguishable.
Queen's Recruit#548.dst: 然而在你們兩人之間……你留下的印象，明顯不如他。你不過是數百、數千人之中的一個……毫無區別。
Queen's Recruit#548.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#549.src: And still, here you stand. It intrigues me. What is so special about you? What strength has led you here?
Queen's Recruit#549.dst: 可你偏偏就站在這裡。這讓我很感興趣。你到底有什麼特別之處？是什麼樣的力量把你帶到這裡的？
Queen's Recruit#549.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#550.src: But no matter. Answers will come with time... should you be selected. I can tell you have a question. Speak it.
Queen's Recruit#550.dst: 不過無妨。答案會隨時間浮現……前提是你被選上。我看得出你有話要問。說吧。
Queen's Recruit#550.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#551.src: Hm. A blank slate... to be able to see the outside world, for all its splendor and all its faults, to witness firsthand the deep rooted seeds of its inevitable destruction... there is value to that.
Queen's Recruit#551.dst: 嗯。一張白紙……能夠親眼見識外面的世界，見識它一切的壯麗與一切的缺陷，親身見證它注定毀滅的那些深植的種子——那是有價值的。
Queen's Recruit#551.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#552.src: You have seen it, haven't you? Forces beyond any of us vie for control of our world, caring not for what destruction they instill.
Queen's Recruit#552.dst: 你已經見過了，不是嗎？超乎我們任何人之上的力量，正在爭奪這個世界的控制權，全然不在乎自己造成了什麼樣的破壞。
Queen's Recruit#552.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#553.src: And it truly is a beautiful world, isn't it? To think, it could be destroyed, taken for their ceaseless war which holds no meaning, no purpose...
Queen's Recruit#553.dst: 而這確實是個美麗的世界，不是嗎？想想看，它竟可能為了那場既無意義也無目的的無盡戰爭，被毀掉、被奪走……
Queen's Recruit#553.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#554.src: Then you have seen firsthand the benefits. The province is unburdened by those who may cause problems, and Wynn's front in its war is bolstered.
Queen's Recruit#554.dst: 那麼你已經親眼看見它的好處了。本行省得以擺脫那些可能製造麻煩的人，而 Wynn 在戰場上的前線也得到了增援。
Queen's Recruit#554.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#555.src: Of course, many will refuse the call. Many grow stagnant in their newfound roles. Yet, in a select few... there is potential for much, much more.
Queen's Recruit#555.dst: 當然，許多人會拒絕這份召喚。許多人會在新的位置上停滯不前。然而在極少數人身上……蘊藏著遠遠更多的可能。
Queen's Recruit#555.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#556.dst: 我很好奇……你是哪一種呢？
Queen's Recruit#556.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#557.src: That will be all. Return to your chambers for the night. I will be sending for the other finalist shortly.
Queen's Recruit#557.dst: 就到這裡。今晚回你的房間去。我很快就會派人去請另一位決賽選手。
Queen's Recruit#557.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#558.src: Return to room W-{~} and talk to Tasim at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

Queen's Recruit#560.src: You're back! Still in one piece?
Queen's Recruit#560.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#561.src: ...I was getting a little worried. You were up there a while.
Queen's Recruit#561.dst: ……我剛才有點擔心。你在上面待了好一陣子。
Queen's Recruit#561.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#563.dst: ……原來如此。所以是一場很怪的對話囉？
Queen's Recruit#563.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#564.src: Ha. Well, now I'm a little nervous.
Queen's Recruit#564.dst: 哈。這下換我有點緊張了。
Queen's Recruit#564.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#566.src: I'll... need to ask some follow-up questions.
Queen's Recruit#566.dst: 我……得問幾個後續問題才行。
Queen's Recruit#566.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#568.src: Oh, this is a disaster. We've been separated, and now we're stuck in here.
Queen's Recruit#568.dst: 哦，這下糟了。我們被拆開了，現在又被困在這裡。
Queen's Recruit#568.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#569.src: We need to come up with a plan... is there a way we could
Queen's Recruit#569.dst: 我們得想個辦法……有沒有可能我們可以——
Queen's Recruit#569.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#570.src: Tasim! Her Majesty will speak with you now.
Queen's Recruit#570.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#572.src: Okay, wish me luck. I'll be back.
Queen's Recruit#572.dst: 好，祝我好運。我去去就回。
Queen's Recruit#572.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#573.src: Don't... stay up waiting for me. You can go rest. I'll be... fine, probably.
Queen's Recruit#573.dst: 別……別熬夜等我。你去休息吧。我會……大概不會有事的。
Queen's Recruit#573.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#578.src: It went... fine, I guess. She probably said... most of the same things to you.
Queen's Recruit#578.dst: 還算……順利吧。她跟你說的……大概也差不多。
Queen's Recruit#578.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#581.src: Could I ask you a favor?
Queen's Recruit#581.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#582.src: Could we spar? A test match, before... before tomorrow. Just like old times.
Queen's Recruit#582.dst: 我們能對練一場嗎？一場試手，在……在明天之前。就像以前那樣。
Queen's Recruit#582.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#583.src: Just, get ready and meet me at the arena. Okay?
Queen's Recruit#583.dst: 你準備好就到競技場找我。好嗎？
Queen's Recruit#583.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#584.src: I yes. I'm okay. Just... could we spar? A test match, before... tomorrow. For old times' sake.
Queen's Recruit#584.dst: 我——嗯。我沒事。只是……我們能對練一場嗎？一場試手，在……明天之前。就當是為了老交情。
Queen's Recruit#584.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#585.src: Just... get ready and meet me at the arena. Okay?
Queen's Recruit#585.dst: 你……準備好就到競技場找我。好嗎？
Queen's Recruit#585.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#588.src: It went... fine, I guess. She probably said... most of the same things to you.
Queen's Recruit#588.dst: 還算……順利吧。她跟你說的……大概也差不多。
Queen's Recruit#588.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#591.src: I was going to ask if I could ask you a favor.
Queen's Recruit#591.dst: 我本來是想問你能不能幫我一個忙的。
Queen's Recruit#591.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#592.src: Could we spar? A test match, before... before tomorrow. Just like old times.
Queen's Recruit#592.dst: 我們能對練一場嗎？一場試手，在……在明天之前。就像以前那樣。
Queen's Recruit#592.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#593.dst: 你準備好就到競技場找我。好嗎？
Queen's Recruit#593.speaker: Tasim
