Queen's Recruit#594.dst: 我——嗯。我沒事。只是……我們能對練一場嗎？一場試手，在……明天之前。就當是為了老交情。
Queen's Recruit#594.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#595.src: Just... get ready and meet me at the arena. Okay?
Queen's Recruit#595.dst: 你……準備好就到競技場找我。好嗎？
Queen's Recruit#595.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#601.src: He's... what what happened? How do you know? How how could you know?
Queen's Recruit#601.dst: 他……什麼——發生什麼事了？你怎麼知道的？你——你怎麼會知道？
Queen's Recruit#601.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#609.src: I... Gods. And, you you've been tr-trying to
Queen's Recruit#609.dst: 我……天啊。而且，你——你一直在試著——
Queen's Recruit#609.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#611.src: I I need to go. I need some space. I'll I'm going to the arena. I need to... to...
Queen's Recruit#611.dst: 我——我得走了。我需要一點空間。我要——我要去競技場。我需要……需要……
Queen's Recruit#611.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#612.src: No. No, d-don't. Don't do that. Not now, not not now. If... if you need me... you'll you'll know where I am.
Queen's Recruit#612.dst: 不要。不、不要，別這樣。現在不要，現在——現在不要。如果……如果你需要我……你會——你會知道我在哪。
Queen's Recruit#612.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#613.src: Head to the arena for a training match against Tasim.
Queen's Recruit#613.dst: 到競技場與 Tasim 進行練習賽。

Queen's Recruit#614.src: Get ready and meet me at the arena. Okay?
Queen's Recruit#614.dst: 你準備好就到競技場找我。好嗎？
Queen's Recruit#614.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#615.src: It's... quiet. No guards in sight.
Queen's Recruit#615.dst: 這裡……好安靜。連一個衛兵都沒有。
Queen's Recruit#615.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#617.src: Sigh. There's no point in trying to get out of here. We have to just see it through to the end.
Queen's Recruit#617.dst: 唉。想逃出去是沒有意義的。我們只能走到最後，把它看完。
Queen's Recruit#617.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#619.src: What do you think? About what she said? About... forces destroying the world.
Queen's Recruit#619.dst: 你怎麼想？關於她說的那些。關於……那些正在毀滅世界的力量。
Queen's Recruit#619.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#620.src: She's right. I've seen it I know you've seen it. It's... getting worse.
Queen's Recruit#620.dst: 她說得對。我見過——我知道你也見過。而且……正在惡化。
Queen's Recruit#620.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#621.src: But... the recruits. The recruits. I can't get over that. It's so...
Queen's Recruit#621.dst: 可是……那些新兵。那些新兵。那件事我過不去。實在太……
Queen's Recruit#621.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#623.src: Let's just get down there and fight. Usual spots, right?
Queen's Recruit#623.dst: 我們就下去打吧。老位置，對吧？
Queen's Recruit#623.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#626.src: No words. Let's fight. Just just a training battle. To... test our skills.
Queen's Recruit#626.dst: 不必多說。開打吧。就只是——就只是一場練習賽。用來……測試我們的身手。
Queen's Recruit#626.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#630.src: I guess we know how tomorrow will turn out, then.
Queen's Recruit#630.dst: 那我想我們都知道明天會是什麼結果了。
Queen's Recruit#630.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#631.src: No don't deny it. We both know I'm right.
Queen's Recruit#631.dst: 不——別否認。我們心裡都清楚我說得對。
Queen's Recruit#631.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#633.src: She gave me a choice, you know?
Queen's Recruit#633.dst: 她給了我一個選擇，你知道嗎？
Queen's Recruit#633.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#634.src: A choice. I don't know what to do with it. And... I'm afraid of taking either option.
Queen's Recruit#634.dst: 一個選擇。我不知道該拿它怎麼辦。而且……兩邊我都害怕去選。
Queen's Recruit#634.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#635.src: I... I need to think over it some more. And we both need to rest.
Queen's Recruit#635.dst: 我……我需要再想一想。而且我們兩個都得休息了。
Queen's Recruit#635.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#636.src: Huh? I... yes. I think I am. I just have a lot on my mind.
Queen's Recruit#636.dst: 嗯？我……嗯。我想我沒事。只是心裡壓著很多事。
Queen's Recruit#636.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#637.src: I'll... tell you in the morning. I just have a lot on my mind.
Queen's Recruit#637.dst: 我……早上再告訴你。我只是心裡壓著很多事。
Queen's Recruit#637.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#638.src: Ha. You're you're good. Oof. I'll be feeling that one for... for a while.
Queen's Recruit#638.dst: 哈。你——你真行。唔。這一下我大概要痛……痛上好一陣子了。
Queen's Recruit#638.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#640.src: Why did it have to come to this? Why couldn't why couldn't we all have just been happy?
Queen's Recruit#640.dst: 為什麼事情非得走到這一步？為什麼——為什麼我們不能就這樣好好的？
Queen's Recruit#640.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#641.src: He he sent me a letter for that mission, you know. Did I tell you that? It's why I went back to Wynn.
Queen's Recruit#641.dst: 他——他為了那個任務寄了封信給我，你知道嗎。我有跟你說過嗎？那就是我回 Wynn 的原因。
Queen's Recruit#641.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#642.src: And, it turns out he was already... already gone. And you were there, and I wasn't.
Queen's Recruit#642.dst: 結果呢，他早就已經……已經走了。而你在場，我不在。
Queen's Recruit#642.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#644.src: I want to blame you for it. I want to be able to be mad, to hate you. But... I can't. I just can't.
Queen's Recruit#644.dst: 我想怪你。我想有辦法生氣，有辦法恨你。可是……我做不到。我就是做不到。
Queen's Recruit#644.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#645.src: I wish I could've been there. I wish I could've done it better. Maybe I could have or maybe it would've just gone the same way.
Queen's Recruit#645.dst: 我多希望當時我在場。我多希望我能做得更好。也許我可以——也許結果還是一樣。
Queen's Recruit#645.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#647.src: And now we're both here in the place we were all exiled from! But he's he isn't. He's gone, and and we're still here.
Queen's Recruit#647.dst: 而現在我們兩個都在這裡，在當初把我們全都流放出去的地方！可是他——他不在。他走了，而——而我們還在。
Queen's Recruit#647.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#648.src: ...what am I supposed to do? What are we supposed to do? About all of this?
Queen's Recruit#648.dst: ……我到底該怎麼辦？我們到底該怎麼辦？面對這一切。
Queen's Recruit#648.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#651.src: I asked a lot of questions. I didn't like all the answers, but... she left me with a choice.
Queen's Recruit#651.dst: 我問了很多問題。那些答案我不是每個都喜歡，但……她留給我一個選擇。
Queen's Recruit#651.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#653.src: I don't know what to do. I need to... to... I need to think.
Queen's Recruit#653.dst: 我不知道該怎麼辦。我需要……需要……我需要想一想。
Queen's Recruit#653.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#654.src: Give me some space, please. I'll see you in the morning.
Queen's Recruit#654.dst: 請給我一點空間。我們早上見。
Queen's Recruit#654.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#655.src: Return to your room and sleep for the night.

Queen's Recruit#657.src: Read the note Tasim left you before heading out.
Queen's Recruit#657.dst: 出發前讀一讀 Tasim 留給你的字條。

Queen's Recruit#658.src: Head to Her Majesty's office for her decision.
Queen's Recruit#658.dst: 前往女王陛下的辦公室聽取她的決定。

Queen's Recruit#660.src: You've already failed, you know. You did not meet her criteria for selection.
Queen's Recruit#660.dst: 你已經失敗了，你知道嗎。你沒有達到她的甄選標準。

Queen's Recruit#661.src: But is dismissing you outright an error? Certainly, you're powerful. Perhaps even more so than you should be, given the circumstances.
Queen's Recruit#661.dst: 不過，直接把你排除掉會不會是個錯誤呢？你確實很強。以你的處境來說，甚至可能強得超出應有的程度。

Queen's Recruit#662.src: Still. You lack the drive, the perspective. The dedication. The understanding.
Queen's Recruit#662.dst: 儘管如此。你缺少那股驅力、那份視野。那份投入。那份理解。

Queen's Recruit#663.src: And, most critically you're unpredictable. And that makes you dangerous.
Queen's Recruit#663.dst: 而且，最關鍵的是——你無法預測。這使你危險。

Queen's Recruit#664.src: Ah! It seems Her Majesty and I have come to the same conclusion. Wonderful.
Queen's Recruit#664.dst: 啊！看來女王陛下和我得出了同樣的結論。太好了。

Queen's Recruit#665.src: So, where does that leave you? Cast out, discarded?
Queen's Recruit#665.dst: 那麼，這讓你落到什麼境地呢？被逐出、被丟棄？

Queen's Recruit#666.src: All the unanswered questions. Will you choose to let go? Dismiss the possibilities?
Queen's Recruit#666.dst: 那麼多沒有答案的問題。你會選擇放手嗎？把那些可能性拋在腦後？

Queen's Recruit#667.src: And if not? What would you do for a glimpse of the truth? For a chance of receiving answers?
Queen's Recruit#667.dst: 如果不呢？為了瞥見真相一眼，你願意做到什麼地步？為了一次得到答案的機會？

Queen's Recruit#668.src: Hm. Whatever the case, the choice is yours. Perhaps you'll surprise me, after all! Wouldn't that be exciting?
Queen's Recruit#668.dst: 嗯。無論如何，選擇權在你。說不定你會讓我意外呢！那不是很有意思嗎？

Queen's Recruit#669.src: {u}, under order of Her Majesty, you are to be escorted out of Fruma, effective immediately.
Queen's Recruit#669.dst: {u}，奉女王陛下之命，你將即刻被護送離開 Fruma。
Queen's Recruit#669.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Queen's Recruit#670.src: Any defiance will be seen as an official threat against Fruma from the Wynn province. Comply, and no one will be hurt.
Queen's Recruit#670.dst: 任何違抗行為，都將被視為 Wynn 行省對 Fruma 的正式威脅。配合行事，就不會有人受傷。
Queen's Recruit#670.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Queen's Recruit#671.src: You hold no power here. This choice is not yours. You will follow orders, or face the consequences.
Queen's Recruit#671.dst: 你在這裡沒有任何權力。這不是你能選擇的。你要麼服從命令，要麼承擔後果。
Queen's Recruit#671.speaker: Gendarme Commander
